1076640.name: Gene expression and T cell repertoire profile at single cell level of peripheral blood T cells after treatment with a personalized neoantigen vaccine (GNOS-PV02) and Pembrolizumab for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma.
1076640.title: Gene expression and T cell repertoire profile at single cell level of peripheral blood T cells after treatment with a personalized neoantigen vaccine (GNOS-PV02) and Pembrolizumab for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma.

1213888.name: Response​ to Tagraxofusp in Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm
1213888.title: Response​ to Tagraxofusp in Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm
1213888.description: Tagraxofusp is a CD123-targeted therapy comprised of a recombinant human interleukin-3 (IL-3) fused to a truncated diphtheria toxin (DT) payload. 772349.name: Identification of somatic changes in tumors from Fanconi anemia patients
772349.title: Identification of somatic changes in tumors from Fanconi anemia patients
772349.description: This study focused on the identification of genomic signatures present in tumors from Fanconi anemia patients. Fanconi anemia is a rare hereditary disease caused by defects in DNA interstrand crosslink repair. The primary patient phenotypes are bone marrow failure and cancer predisposition. 1226668.name: Studying Glioblastoma in a Human Organoid Tumor Transplantation Model
1226668.title: Studying Glioblastoma in a Human Organoid Tumor Transplantation Model
1226668.description: This study comprises two complementary investigations that leverage innovative human model systems and cutting-edge molecular profiling to dissect glioblastoma (GBM) heterogeneity and tumor-microenvironment interactions. The first study uses a novel Human Organoid Tumor Transplantation (HOTT) model, in which freshly dissociated GBM tumor cells from five patients were transplanted into human embryonic stem cell-derived cortical organoids. 667060.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing samples from high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC)
667060.description: We measured gene expression in single-cell RNA sequencing samples from patients with high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC), for a study on improving HGSOC subtype definition by taking into account varying cell type proportions within tumors. Overall design: Gene expression was measured at single-cell level using single-cell RNA sequencing performed on HGSOC samples from separate, unrelated individuals. 672929.title: In-depth transcriptomic analyses investigating molecular mechanisms underlying diabetic retinopathy (smallRNA)
672929.description: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is among the major global causes for vision loss. With the rise in diabetes prevalence, an increase in DR incidence is expected. Current understanding of both the molecular etiology and pathways involved in the initiation and progression of DR is limited. 976395.name: Adipocyte associated glucocorticoid signaling regulates normal fibroblast function which is lost in inflammatory arthritis [synovium_scRNA-seq]
976395.title: Adipocyte associated glucocorticoid signaling regulates normal fibroblast function which is lost in inflammatory arthritis [synovium_scRNA-seq]
976395.description: Fibroblasts play critical roles in tissue homeostasis, but in pathologic states can drive fibrosis, inflammation, and tissue destruction. In the joint synovium, fibroblasts provide homeostatic maintenance and lubrication. Little is known about what regulates the homeostatic functions of fibroblasts in healthy conditions. 1199066.name: Single Cell Profiling of Transcriptional and Epigenetic Differences Between Virus and Severity in Infants Infected with SARS-CoV-2 and RSV
1199066.title: Single Cell Profiling of Transcriptional and Epigenetic Differences Between Virus and Severity in Infants Infected with SARS-CoV-2 and RSV
1199066.description: This study compares the transcriptional and epigenetic immune responses to SARS-CoV-2 and RSV in infant PBMCs across different disease severities. Infants and young children hospitalized with SARS-CoV-2 (n=30) or RSV (n=19) were enrolled from February 2019 through January 2022. 1369579.title: Single nucleus and spatial transcriptomic analyses of pulmonary fibrosis from the “Lung Transplant” and “Lung Tissue” Biorepositories

947535.name: Epigenetic and transcriptomic characterization reveals progression markers and essential pathways in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
947535.title: Epigenetic and transcriptomic characterization reveals progression markers and essential pathways in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
947535.description: Identifying tumor-cell-specific markers and elucidating their epigenetic regulation and spatial heterogeneity provides mechanistic insights into cancer etiology. Here, we have performed snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq in 34 and 28 human clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) specimens, respectively, with matched bulk proteogenomics data. 764786.name: Multi-omic Investigation of Beckwith-Wiedemann Syndrome Hepatoblasto
764786.title: Multi-omic Investigation of Beckwith-Wiedemann Syndrome Hepatoblasto
764786.description: Hepatoblastoma (HB) is the most common malignant liver tumor diagnosed in children under 5 years of age. One of the most common HB predisposition syndromes is Beckwith-Wiedemann Syndrome (BWS, OMIM 130650), which affects approximately 1/10,000 live births. In this study, we perform Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), DNA methylation array, messenger RNA-Sequencing (mRNA-Seq), and microRNA-Sequencing (miRNA-Seq) to examine the genomic, methylomic, and transcriptomic signature of BWS HB. 1373318.name: Single-cell eQTL and multiome profiling of normal lung tissues for functional characterization of lung cancer risk-associated genomic loci
1373318.title: Single-cell eQTL and multiome profiling of normal lung tissues for functional characterization of lung cancer risk-associated genomic loci
1373318.description: This study was performed to identify cell-type-specific genetic regulation of gene expression in human lung tissues. 1173250.name: MR1T Cells at Birth Have Diverse TCR Usage, are Less Cytotoxic and are Unable to Respond to Many Common Childhood Pathogens
1173250.title: MR1T Cells at Birth Have Diverse TCR Usage, are Less Cytotoxic and are Unable to Respond to Many Common Childhood Pathogens
1173250.description: This study enrolled healthy adult participants and expectant mothers from the Portland, USA area and consent was obtained. Adult participants donated blood from which peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) were collected. From expectant mothers, umbilical cord blood samples were collected at the time of delivery and cord blood mononuclear cells were obtained (CBMC). 1037044.name: Distinct baseline immune characteristics associated with responses to conjugated and unconjugated pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccines in older adults [scRNA-seq]
1037044.title: Distinct baseline immune characteristics associated with responses to conjugated and unconjugated pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccines in older adults [scRNA-seq]
1037044.description: Pneumococcal infections cause serious illness and death among older adults. A capsular polysaccharide vaccine PPSV23 (Pneumovax®) and a conjugated polysaccharide vaccine PCV13 (Prevnar®) are used to prevent these infections, yet underlying immunological responses, and baseline predictors remain unknown. 1253788.name: HuBMAP: Penn Center for Multi-scale Molecular Mapping of the Female Reproductive System
1253788.title: HuBMAP: Penn Center for Multi-scale Molecular Mapping of the Female Reproductive System
1253788.description: The female reproductive system, the uterus, fallopian tubes and the ovaries, is a complex interrelated set of organs that is physiologically dynamic and not only important for fertility but critically interrelated with general health. 796651.title: Dissecting Cell Composition and Drug Sensitivity in Human Adenoid Cystic Carcinomas (ACCs)
796651.description: The study reports the results of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), RNA sequencing (RNA-seq), and whole-exome sequencing (WES) experiments performed on malignant cells isolated by flow cytometry from seven patient-derived xenograft (PDX) lines established from human Adenoid Cystic Carcinomas (ACCs). 391406.name: Homo sapiens
391406.title: IFNγ-dependent tissue immune homeostasis is co-opted in the tumor microenvironment
391406.description: Homeostatic programs maintain equilibrium between immune protection, and selftolerance. Such mechanisms impact autoimmunity and tumor formation, respectively. How tissue homeostasis is maintained, and impacts tumor surveillance is unknown. 1347104.name: Healthy Donor Controls for Immune Evaluation
1347104.title: Healthy Donor Controls for Immune Evaluation
1347104.description: Bioenergetic dysfunction is an archetypical finding in critical illness, particularly among patients with sepsis. A central feature of sepsis is the shift towards pathologic immunosuppression predisposing to secondary infections and ineffectual organ recovery. However, the extent to which metabolic abnormalities contribute to immune cell dysregulation in critically ill patients with and without sepsis remains unclear. 1244940.title: Neurogenetic studies of trichotillomania and excoriation disorder
1244940.description: The overall objective of this study is to use a series of state-of-the-art neurogenetic approaches to advance our understanding of the genes and pathways that contribute to trichotillomania and excoriation disorder. In aim 1, we will use whole-exome DNA sequencing to examine rare sequence variants in 200 parent-child trios where the child has trichotillomania or excoriation disorder. 591014.name: A single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-Seq toolbox for fresh and frozen human tumors
591014.title: A single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-Seq toolbox for fresh and frozen human tumors
591014.description: Single cell genomics is essential to chart tumor ecosystems. While single cell RNA-Seq (scRNA-Seq) profiles RNA from cells dissociated from fresh tumors, single nucleus RNA-Seq (snRNA-Seq) is needed to profile frozen or hard-to-dissociate tumors. Each requires customization to different tissue and tumor types, posing a barrier to adoption. 1151742.title: Programs, Origins, and Immunomodulatory Functions of Myeloid Cells in Gliomas

1016055.title: The Chromatin Landscape of Pathogenic Transcriptional Cell States in Rheumatoid Arthritis
1016055.description: In this study, we characterized 24 rheumatoid arthritis (RA) synovial tissue chromatin classes (i.e., cell states defined by chromatin accessibility) across 5 cell types (T, B/plasma, myeloid, stromal, and endothelial). 736761.title: Circulating tumor cell heterogeneity in neuroendocrine prostate cancer by single cell copy number analysis

1338254.title: Pilot Study to Investigate the Pathogenesis of Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis
1338254.description: The study investigates how immune and stromal cells are organized within inflamed synovium in juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA). 1373312.title: RNAseq of human nasal epithelial cultures infected with rhinovirus
1373312.description: Rhinovirus (RV) is the most frequent cause of common colds, but also a major cause of serious respiratory illness in high-risk groups (e.g., smokers and asthmatics). 267619.title: Single Cell Analysis Program-Transcriptomics (SCAP-T) (Penn site)
267619.description: The goal of this study is to characterize and understand the variability in the expressed transcriptome of human excitable cells. There are two predominant types of excitable cell in the human body, neurons and muscle cells, including cardiac cells. These studies, while clinically informative, are unable to delineate mutation order as well as clonal architecture and complexity. 484871.title: Mixed-Effects Association of Single Cells Identifies an Expanded Effector CD4+ T Cell Subset in Rheumatoid Arthritis

1149105.title: Developing Allelic Imbalance Analysis from Single-Nucleus RNA-seq Data
1149105.description: Single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) is emerging as a powerful tool for understanding gene function across diverse cells. Recently, this has included the use of allele-specific expression (ASE) analysis to better understand how variation in the human genome affects RNA expression at the single-cell level. 1034641.title: Transfer learning associates CAFs with EMT and inflammation in tumor cells in human tumors and organoid co-culture in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma [MULTIseq]

904019.title: Human blastocyst lOX single cell RNA sequencing

One limitation of our first protocol for human blastoid generation was relatively low efficiency. 1373321.title: Parkinson Cell Atlas in 5D (PD5D)
1373321.description: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have unequivocally linked thousands of noncoding variants to Parkinson's disease (PD). Why have these breakthroughs not uncovered the mechanism(s) of common, genetically complex PD? We do not know how GWAS variants cause neurodegeneration, which variants are causal, and why they impair some brain cells but not others. 995802.title: The origin and dynamics of cellular heterogeneity vary across lineage subtypes of castrate resistant prostate cancer [scRNA-seq]
995802.description: Cancer cells often adapt a stem-like state resulting in lineage plasticity and phenotypic heterogeneity. We assessed the dynamics of lineage determination and cellular subpopulation expansion in treatment-resistant adenocarcinoma, amphicrine, and small cell neuroendocrine castrate resistant prostate cancers. 1288050.title: Numbat-multiome: Inferring copy number variation by combining RNA and chromatin accessibility information from single-cell data
1288050.description: Numbat-multiome is a computational framework designed to infer copy number variations (CNVs) by integrating RNA and chromatin accessibility data from single-cell multiomic datasets. 923100.title: Combined PD-1, BRAF and MEK inhibition in BRAFV600E colorectal cancer: a phase 2 trial
923100.description: In this study, we evaluated the clinical efficacy of combined PDCD1, BRAF, and MAP2K7 inhibition in metastatic BRAFV600E Colorectal Cancer (CRC) patients (NCT03668431). 1082805.title: Combinatorial Indexed 10x Genomics Single-cell ATAC-seq on Human Cerebral Cortex

961895.title: Spatiotemporal charting of human esophageal development for epidermolysis bullosa cell therapy
961895.description: Human fetal esophageal development is not well understood. We present a spatio-temporal single-cell multi-omics atlas to close such a long-standing knowledge gap. 935426.title: Structurally complex osteosarcoma genomes exhibit limited heterogeneity within individual tumors and across evolutionary time

However, published models explaining how these genomic rearrangements occur disagree about if these rearrangements occur early in tumor progression and then are stable afterwards, or if there is ongoing genomic instability. 668295.name: Identification of a minority population in breast cancer that integrates into the vasculature and initiates metastasis [scRNA-Seq]
668295.title: Identification of a minority population in breast cancer that integrates into the vasculature and initiates metastasis [scRNA-Seq]

1080534.title: Long-Read Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Enables Cell Genotyping to Refine Subclone Detection in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia

663623.title: Simultaneous trimodal single cell measurement of transcripts, epitopes, and chromatin accessibility using TEA-seq
663623.description: Single-cell measurements of cellular characteristics have been instrumental in understanding the heterogeneous pathways that drive differentiation, cellular responses to signals, and human disease. Recent advances have allowed paired capture of protein abundance and transcriptomic state, but a lack of epigenetic information in these assays has left a missing link to gene regulation. 793427.name: Deciphering Tumor Cell Evolution in Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphomas: Distinct Differentiation Trajectories in Mycosis Fungoides and Sézary Syndrome
793427.title: Deciphering Tumor Cell Evolution in Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphomas: Distinct Differentiation Trajectories in Mycosis Fungoides and Sézary Syndrome
793427.description: Cutaneous T-cell lymphomas are a heterogeneous group of neoplasms originating in the skin, with mycosis fungoides (MF) and Sézary syndrome (SS) representing the most common variants. 622296.description: Leukemia initiating cells (LICs) self-renew indefinitely to fuel leukemic growth and spark disease relapse. Here, we use single cell transcriptomics to dissect the ontogeny of MLL-rearranged B-lymphoblastic leukemia (MLL-r B-ALL). 735210.name: A single cell atlas of human adipose tissue
735210.title: A single cell atlas of human adipose tissue
735210.description: White adipose tissue (WAT), once regarded as morphologically and functionally bland, is now recognized to be dynamic, plastic, heterogenous, and involved in a wide array of biological processes including energy homeostasis, glucose and lipid handling, blood pressure control, and host defense. 1148225.name: Single-cell analysis of the multiple myeloma microenvironment after g-secretase inhibition and CAR T-cell therapy
1148225.title: Single-cell analysis of the multiple myeloma microenvironment after g-secretase inhibition and CAR T-cell therapy
1148225.description: We examined the effects of gamma-secretase inhibition (GSI) on the bone marrow microenvironment in multiple myeloma patients before anti-B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA) CAR T-cell therapy. Single-nuclei RNA and ATAC sequencing revealed significant changes in gene expression and chromatin accessibility, especially in monocytes and tumor cells, following exposure to GSI. 1138809.name: Mutation patterns predict drug response in acute myeloid leukemia
1138809.title: Mutation patterns predict drug response in acute myeloid leukemia
1138809.description: As part of a study correlating co-occurring mutations in Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) with drug sensitivity, we performed single cell mutation analysis to document the subclonal composition for 8 patient samples (blood or marrow mononuclear cells) of the 99 patients studied. We utilized the Tapestri Single Cell DNA plus Protein Sequencing Kit (MissionBio) and the 45-gene myeloid panel (MissionBio) for targeted sequencing. Single cells were encapsulated, lysed, and barcoded. DNA and protein libra

615002.name: CLL relapse after allo-HSCT
615002.title: CLL relapse after allo-HSCT
615002.description: We investigated the molecular dynamics driving relapse of chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant (allo-HSCT) through an integrated analysis of whole exome, bulk transcriptome, bulk methylome and single cell transcriptional data from paired leukemic samples representing 19 patients. We found that their clinical kinetics corresponded to distinct genetic and epigenetic evolutionary trajectories and suggest that the selection pressures of the post-

545332.name: single cell RNA-seq analysis of adult and paediatric IDH-wildtype Glioblastomas
545332.title: single cell RNA-seq analysis of adult and paediatric IDH-wildtype Glioblastomas
545332.description: To understand the diversity of expression states in IDH-wildtype Glioblastomas, we profiled 24,131 single cells from 28 patients with GBM by single-cell RNA sequencing (7,930 cells by Smartseq2 and 16,201 by 10X). 1062914.title: Cell type-specific and disease-associated eQTL in the human lung
1062914.description: This study was conducted to investigate the genetic control of gene expression in a cell-type and context-specific manner in the human lung. We performed single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) of lung tissue from 66 Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD) cases and 48 unaffected donors. Employing a pseudo-bulk approach, we mapped expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) across 38 cell types. 726829.name: Characterization of CNS Metastases
726829.title: Characterization of CNS Metastases
726829.description: Metastatic disease to the central nervous system (CNS) is devastating, with a poor prognosis. There are limited treatment options for patients with CNS metastases, and in particular with leptomeningeal carcinomatosis (LMD). In this study, we evaluated the molecular and cellular features of parenchymal brain metastases and LMD. 671343.name: HubMAP: KULMAP - Human Kidney, Urinary Tract, and Lung Mapping Center
671343.title: HubMAP: KULMAP - Human Kidney, Urinary Tract, and Lung Mapping Center
671343.description: The major goal of the Human Kidney, Urinary Tract, and Lung Mapping Centers at the Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis and University of Rochester Medical College is to generate multi-omic and spatially resolved 2D and 3D molecular anatomical maps of the human bladder, ureter and kidney and the lung airways and parenchyma at a single cell resolution. 755316.name: Single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq uncovers shared and distinct axes of variation in dorsal LGN neurons in mice, non-human primates, and humans
755316.title: Single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq uncovers shared and distinct axes of variation in dorsal LGN neurons in mice, non-human primates, and humans
755316.description: Abundant evidence supports the presence of at least three distinct types of thalamocortical (TC) neurons in the primate dorsal lateral geniculate nucleus (dLGN) of the thalamus, the brain region that conveys visual information from the retina to the primary visual cortex (V1). 1113649.name: Single cell RNA-sequencing reveals molecular signatures that distinguish allergic from irritant contact dermatitis
1113649.title: Single cell RNA-sequencing reveals molecular signatures that distinguish allergic from irritant contact dermatitis
1113649.description: Allergic and irritant contact dermatitis can be challenging to distinguish. We used single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and insterstitial fluid proteomic analysis to compare suction blister biopsy skin samples from human volunteers with induced allergic and irritant contact dermatitis reactions. 1172795.name: HIV DAb-seq of ART-treated individuals
1172795.title: HIV DAb-seq of ART-treated individuals
1172795.description: Despite effective antiretroviral therapy (ART), HIV remains an incurable disease. The latent HIV reservoir is a central obstacle to a cure. It consists of rare CD4+ cells harboring replication-competent proviral DNA that inevitably resumes viremia upon ART interruption. 374527.name: Homo sapiens
374527.title: Single-cell RNA-seq reveals new types of human blood dendritic cells, monocytes and progenitors
374527.description: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were isolated from fresh blood using Ficoll-Paque density gradient centrifugation. 846154.name: Clonally expanded CD38hi cytotoxic CD8 T cells define the T cell infiltrate in checkpoint inhibitor-associated arthritis
846154.title: Clonally expanded CD38hi cytotoxic CD8 T cells define the T cell infiltrate in checkpoint inhibitor-associated arthritis
846154.description: Immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapies have improved outcomes for advanced malignancies by activating T cell responses, yet often also elicit harmful autoimmune reactions. The T cell mechanisms mediating these iatrogenic autoimmune events remain unclear. Here we focused on ICI-induced inflammatory arthritis (ICI-arthritis), which can clinically present indistinguishable from rheumatoid arthritis (RA). 374387.name: Homo sapiens
374387.title: Health Cell Atlas Of Human Blood Dendritic Cells and Monocytes
374387.description: Dendritic cells (DC) and monocytes play a central role in pathogen sensing, phagocytosis and antigen presentation, and consist of multiple specialized subtypes. However, their identities and inter-relationships are not fully understood as these populations have historically been defined by a combination of morphology, physical properties, localization, functions, developmental origins, and expression of a restricted set of surface markers. 560989.title: SINGLE CELL ANALYSIS OF THE HUMAN PLACENTA
560989.description: Pregnancy and parturition is a complex physiological process requiring a well-orchestrated dialogue between the mother and fetus. The samples collected in this study aim to elucidate using single cell genomics the cellular mechanisms and molecular communications that facilitate maternal-fetal crosstalk during pregnancy and in labor both in healthy and pathological conditions. 1276165.name: INCLUDE: Down syndrome early post-natal basal forebrain multiome
1276165.title: INCLUDE: Down syndrome early post-natal basal forebrain multiome
1276165.description: Neurodevelopmental deficiencies and neuronal dysfunction contribute to cognitive impairment in individuals with Down syndrome, but what molecular pathways underlie the defects that lead to intellectual disability remain unclear. 1140521.name: Baseline Immune State and T cell Clonal Kinetics are Associated with Response to CAR-T Therapy in Large B-cell Lymphoma
1140521.title: Baseline Immune State and T cell Clonal Kinetics are Associated with Response to CAR-T Therapy in Large B-cell Lymphoma
1140521.description: Engineered cellular therapy with CD19-targeting chimeric antigen receptor T-cells (CAR-T) has revolutionized outcomes for patients with relapsed/refractory Large B-Cell Lymphoma (LBCL), but the cellular and molecular features associated with response remain largely unresolved. 1308196.title: Sequencing of rare pancreatic tumors that respond to PD-1 blockade
1308196.description: Pancreatic cancer is nearly always refractory to immunotherapy, except in a rare subset of patients whose tumors have a high mutational burden (TMB), usually due to mismatch-repair deficiency. 1091798.name: A single cell framework identifies functionally and molecularly distinct multipotent progenitors in adult human hematopoiesis
1091798.title: A single cell framework identifies functionally and molecularly distinct multipotent progenitors in adult human hematopoiesis
1091798.description: Hematopoietic multipotent progenitors (MPPs) regulate blood cell production to appropriately meet the biological demands of the human body. Human MPPs remain ill-defined whereas mouse MPPs have been well characterized with distinct immunophenotypes and lineage potencies. 1368931.name: Single cell and spatial transcriptomic profiling of pustule formers and resolvers of Haemophilus ducreyi infection following a second challenge
1368931.title: Single cell and spatial transcriptomic profiling of pustule formers and resolvers of Haemophilus ducreyi infection following a second challenge

947748.title: Single Cell Genotypic and Phenotypic Analysis of Measurable Residual Disease in Acute Myeloid Leukemia
947748.description: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a group of blood cancers with high mortality. Even though complete remission is often achieved, majority of the AML patients still relapse. Measurable residual disease (MRD), defined as the population of cancer cells which persists following chemotherapy, is responsible for AML relapse. 998545.title: Spatial transcriptomics analysis of neoadjuvant cabozantinib and nivolumab in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma identifies independent mechanisms of resistance and recurrence

796650.name: Dissecting Cell Composition and Drug Sensitivity in Human Adenoid Cystic Carcinomas (ACCs)
796650.title: Dissecting Cell Composition and Drug Sensitivity in Human Adenoid Cystic Carcinomas (ACCs)
796650.description: The study reports the results of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), RNA sequencing (RNA-seq), and whole-exome sequencing (WES) experiments performed on malignant cells isolated by flow cytometry from seven patient-derived xenograft (PDX) lines established from human Adenoid Cystic Carcinomas (ACCs). 524362.title: Expression profiling of PBMCs from VA-ECLS patients

1263046.title: Uncovering gene regulatory differences between human and chimpanzee neural cells

1087436.title: Single cell resolution analysis of multi-tissue derived human iNKT cells reveals novel transcriptional paradigms
1087436.description: Invariant natural killer T (iNKT) cells are evolutionarily conserved innate lymphocytes important for host defense against pathogens. Further, they are increasingly recognized to play a role in tumor immune surveillance and in protection against graft versus host disease, and they are of particular importance as a universal donor for cellular therapies. 768498.title: The Spatio-Temporal Evolution of Multiple Myeloma from Baseline to Relapse-Refractory States
768498.description: In multiple myeloma, the spatio-temporal evolution patterns of cancer cells in the bone marrow remain largely unknown. Here, we applied spatial-longitudinal sequencing, including a total of 179 samples collected from 25 patients during a follow-up of up to 14 years. 1020568.title: Multimodal gene expression and chromatin accessibility profiles at the single-cell level of synovial tissue from individuals with arthritis
1020568.description: In this study, we sought to understand the cell states in which autoimmune disease heritability is enriched. 1377643.title: scRNAseq Analysis of Osteosarcoma Reveals Conserved and Distinct Ecosystems Across Sites and Species

753520.title: Atlas of Clinically Distinct Cell States and Cellular Ecosystems Across Human Solid Tumors
753520.description: Determining how cells vary with their local signaling environment and organize into distinct cellular communities is critical for understanding processes as diverse as development, aging, and cancer. 1141508.title: Vascular invasion-associated gene expression is detectable in pre-surgical biopsies of stage I lung adenocarcinoma [bulkRNA-seq]
1141508.description: Microscopic vascular invasion (VI) predicts recurrence and benefit from lobectomy in stage I lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) but cannot be accurately predicted before surgery. 681646.title: Interdependencies of Intratumoral Genetic Heterogeneity and the Immune Microenvironment in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
681646.description: Tumor microenvironment (TME) and somatic mutations drive progression of chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL). 1043165.title: Remodeling of the immune microenvironment is linked to adverse outcome in pediatric T cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia

951465.title: Deterministic evolution and stringent selection during pre-neoplasia

649823.title: Multimodal Mapping of the Immune Landscape in Human Pancreatic Cancer

1256939.title: High-resolution single cell profiling of SARS-CoV-2 vaccine responsiveness in healthy adults
1256939.description: mRNA vaccines, administered in two doses, have been highly effective against SARS-CoV-2 and are now being explored for broader applications. 753770.title: Progressively overloaded single-cell RNA-seq with cell hashing

476644.description: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) produce durable responses in some melanoma patients, but many patients derive no clinical benefit, and the molecular underpinnings of such resistance remain elusive. Here, we leveraged single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) from 31 melanoma tumors and novel computational methods to interrogate malignant cell states that promote immune evasion. We identified a resistance program expressed by malignant cells that is associated with T cell exclusion and immune evasion. T

686999.name: Transcriptional Profiling of Pediatric Cholestatic Livers Identifies Three Distinct Macrophage Populations
686999.title: Transcriptional Profiling of Pediatric Cholestatic Livers Identifies Three Distinct Macrophage Populations
686999.description: We characterize three subpopulations of cholestatic macrophages in pediatric patients with biliary atresia (BA) and Alagille syndrome (ALGS). Overall design: single-cell RNA-seq of liver biopsies Note: This GEO submission contains only processed data. The submitter will upload the raw data files to dbGap due to patient privacy issue.

609182.name: A single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-Seq toolbox for fresh and frozen human tumors
609182.title: A single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-Seq toolbox for fresh and frozen human tumors
609182.description: Single cell transcriptomics is a powerful tool to map the complex tumor microenvironment, providing unprecedented resolution into cell types, cell states, cell interactions, and tumor heterogeneity. Depending on their tissue site and whether processing begins from a fresh or frozen sample, different tumors require different optimizations in order to obtain high quality single cell transcriptomic data. 990791.name: Deconvolution of the mechanisms of T cell drug response in multiple myeloma induction therapy
990791.title: Deconvolution of the mechanisms of T cell drug response in multiple myeloma induction therapy
990791.description: In this study, we characterize the effect of bortezomib, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone on T cells, with the help of high-quality datasets generated using the trimodal single-cell genomics method TEA-seq, which captures mRNA transcripts, cell surface epitopes, and chromatin accessibility. 1281734.name: Pyoderma gangrenosum caused by molecular uncoupling of OTULIN catalytic activity and LUBAC binding
1281734.title: Pyoderma gangrenosum caused by molecular uncoupling of OTULIN catalytic activity and LUBAC binding
1281734.description: This is a single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) study using peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) from 3 healthy donors and 2 patients with OTULIN-related Pyoderma Gangrenosum (ORP). Samples were not hashed or multiplexed. The 10X Genomics Platform was used for sequencing. 1081500.name: Aberrant activation of wound healing programs within the metastatic niche facilitates lung colonization by osteosarcoma cells
1081500.title: Aberrant activation of wound healing programs within the metastatic niche facilitates lung colonization by osteosarcoma cells
1081500.description: Lung metastasis is responsible for nearly all deaths caused by osteosarcoma, the most common pediatric bone tumor. How malignant bone cells coerce the lung microenvironment to support metastatic growth is unclear. 759182.name: The Landscape of Tumor Cell States and Ecosystems in Diffuse Large B Cell Lymphoma [scVDJ-seq]
759182.title: The Landscape of Tumor Cell States and Ecosystems in Diffuse Large B Cell Lymphoma [scVDJ-seq]
759182.description: Biological heterogeneity in diffuse large B cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is partly driven by cell-of-origin subtypes and associated genomic lesions, but also by diverse cell types and cell states in the tumor microenvironment (TME). However, dissecting these cell states and their clinical relevance at scale remains challenging. 961307.name: MAITS in HCC
961307.title: MAITS in HCC
961307.description: Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related death and can be considered a prototype of inflammation-derived cancer arising from chronic liver injury. The cell composition of the HCC tumor immune microenvironment (TiME) has a major impact on cancer biology as the TiME can have divergent capacities on tumor initiation, progress, and response to therapy. 356914.name: Homo sapiens
356914.title: Molecular Evolution of Cancer
356914.description: Recently developed methods that utilize partitioning of long genomic DNA fragments, and barcoding of shorter fragments derived from them, have succeeded in retaining long-range information in short sequencing reads. These so-called read cloud approaches represent a powerful, accurate, and cost-effective alternative to single-molecule long-read sequencing. 677986.name: Single Nucleus RNA-Seq Multiomic Profiling Reveals Age-Dynamic Regulation of Host Genes Associated with SARS-CoV-2 Infection [scRNA-Seq]
677986.title: Single Nucleus RNA-Seq Multiomic Profiling Reveals Age-Dynamic Regulation of Host Genes Associated with SARS-CoV-2 Infection [scRNA-Seq]
677986.description: Respiratory failure is the leading cause of COVID-19 death and disproportionately impacts adults more than children. Here, we present a large-scale snATAC-seq dataset (90,980 nuclei) of the human lung, generated in parallel with snRNA-seq (46,500 nuclei), from healthy donors of ~30 weeks, ~3 years and ~30 years of age. 1227598.name: Single cell and spatial transcriptomics studies of Fibrosis in Prospective Registry in IBD Study at MGH and GI Disease and Endoscopy Registry
1227598.title: Single cell and spatial transcriptomics studies of Fibrosis in Prospective Registry in IBD Study at MGH and GI Disease and Endoscopy Registry
1227598.description: Stricturing disease or fibrosis is a common complication of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), often requiring surgical intervention. This process is caused by the abnormal deposition of extracellular matrix in the context of inflammation, and thus involves crosstalk between multiple cell types including fibroblasts and immune cells. 671244.name: HubMAP: A Spatially Resolved Molecular Atlas of Human Endothelium
671244.title: HubMAP: A Spatially Resolved Molecular Atlas of Human Endothelium
671244.description: The human circulatory system plays a vital role in the proper functioning of every organ in the human body. Because vascular related diseases, such as atherosclerosis, do not occur homogeneously throughout the vascular tree, differences in the endothelium of various organs must exist. There is even evidence of heterogeneity of adjacent endothelial cells. 791349.name: Multi-modal single-cell and whole-genome sequencing of minute, frozen specimens to propel clinical applications
791349.title: Multi-modal single-cell and whole-genome sequencing of minute, frozen specimens to propel clinical applications
791349.description: We provide 5’ and/or 3’ single cell and single nuclei RNA sequencing data for matched comparisons of profiling from fresh (single cells) and frozen (single nuclei) samples of a non small cell lung cancer sample, a cutaneous melanoma sample , and a primary uveal melanoma sample. Next, we profiled three sequential biopsies (one pre-treatment and two on-treatment) from the KEYNOTE-001 trial by 5’ single-nuclei RNA sequencing from frozen specimens. 667716.name: Single Cell Analyses of Renal Cell Cancers Reveal Insights into Tumor Microenvironment, Cell of Origin, and Therapy Response
667716.title: Single Cell Analyses of Renal Cell Cancers Reveal Insights into Tumor Microenvironment, Cell of Origin, and Therapy Response
667716.description: Diverse subtypes of renal cell carcinomas (RCC) display a wide spectrum of histomorphologies, proteogenomic alterations, immune cell infiltration patterns, and clinical behavior. Delineating the ontogeny of these malignancies with the identification of cells of origin for different RCC subtypes will provide mechanistic insights into their diverse pathobiology. 1367139.name: Genome-scale spatial mapping of the Hodgkin lymphoma microenvironment
1367139.title: Genome-scale spatial mapping of the Hodgkin lymphoma microenvironment
1367139.description: A central challenge in cancer research is to identify the secreted factors that sustain tumor cell survival. This is best exemplified in Hodgkin lymphoma, where malignant cells constitute a minor fraction of the tumor and rely on signals from the microenvironment for survival. 994264.name: Investigating delayed-onset Drug Hypersensitivity Reactions Prospectively
994264.title: Investigating delayed-onset Drug Hypersensitivity Reactions Prospectively
994264.description: Delayed-type drug hypersensitivity reactions (dtDHR) are significant causes of morbidity and mortality, but the origin, phenotype and function of pathogenic T cells across the spectrum of severity are unknown. Research has been hampered by several barriers. 934666.name: Single Cell DNA Methylation Analysis for Forensic Epigenetics
934666.title: Single Cell DNA Methylation Analysis for Forensic Epigenetics
934666.description: As part of the Epigenetic CHaracterization and Observation (ECHO) program, the Genomic Analysis Laboratory at the Salk Institute generated the DNA methylation profiles of certain PBMC cell types to determine the change in methylation levels before, during or after exposure to certain biological or chemical agents. 744860.title: Single cell analysis reveals mechanisms of heterogeneity and plasticity of leukemia initiating cells [CITEseq]
744860.description: Leukemia initiating cells (LICs) self-renew indefinitely to fuel leukemic growth and spark disease relapse.  Previously thought to be primitive and rare, the LIC state may actually be heterogeneous and dynamic, allowing LICs to evade therapy. 807046.name: Multiplexed scRNA-seq reveals cellular and genetic correlates of SLE
807046.title: Multiplexed scRNA-seq reveals cellular and genetic correlates of SLE
807046.description: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a heterogeneous autoimmune disease. Knowledge of circulating immune cell types and cell states associated with SLE remains incomplete. We profiled over 1.2 million PBMCs (160 cases, 98 controls) with multiplexed single-cell RNA-seq (mux-seq). 1078931.name: Spatial transcriptomics reveals discrete tumour microenvironments and autocrine loops within ovarian cancer subclones
1078931.title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals discrete tumour microenvironments and autocrine loops within ovarian cancer subclones
1078931.description: Ovarian masses from patients with high grade serous ovarian carcinoma undergoing debulking surgery were subjected to spatial transcriptomics profiling using the 10x Genomics Visium (fresh frozen) platform. Copy number inference using inferCNV predicted the presence of subclones with mutually exclusive copy number alterations (CNAs) in 5 of the 8 patient samples studied. 926598.name: Non-small Cell Lung Cancer Brain Metastasis Atlas [lpWGS]
926598.title: Non-small Cell Lung Cancer Brain Metastasis Atlas [lpWGS]
926598.description: We performed single nuclei RNA-sequencing (snRNA-seq) with matched T cell receptor sequencing (TCR-seq), and pool matched low pass whole genome sequencing (WGS)  of 12 treatment-naïve non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) primary tumors  (PTs) and 31  treatment-naïve NSCLC brain metastases (BMs) . 1185830.name: Longitudinal Multi-omic Immune Resource Reveals Dynamic Responses in Healthy Human Aging
1185830.title: Longitudinal Multi-omic Immune Resource Reveals Dynamic Responses in Healthy Human Aging
1185830.description: The generation and maintenance of protective immunity is a dynamic interplay between host and environment that is impacted by age. Understanding fundamental changes in the healthy immune system that occur over a lifespan is critical in developing interventions for age-related susceptibility to infections and diseases. 1373320.title: Parkinson Cell Atlas in 5D (PD5D)
1373320.description: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have unequivocally linked thousands of noncoding variants to Parkinson's disease (PD). Why have these breakthroughs not uncovered the mechanism(s) of common, genetically complex PD? We do not know how GWAS variants cause neurodegeneration, which variants are causal, and why they impair some brain cells but not others. 516635.name: The altered DNA methylation landscape in chronic lymphocytic leukemia emerges early and persists after treatment
516635.title: The altered DNA methylation landscape in chronic lymphocytic leukemia emerges early and persists after treatment
516635.description: Here we measured genome-wide DNA methylation in patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia as it provides an opportunity to capture the emergence of altered methylation landscapes as well as track their dynamics over disease progression including after treatment. 928684.title: Single cell RNA sequencing of pancreastic cancer associated fibroblasts (CAFs) exposed to hypoxia
928684.description: Single cell RNA sequencing of cancer associated fibroblasts cultured in hypoxia and normoxia environments Overall design: Total 81 HCCs with PET information were sequenced to identify gene expressions. 659732.title: Multimodal Analysis for Human ex vivo Studies Shows Extensive Molecular Changes from Delays in Blood Processing
659732.description: Multi-omic profiling of human peripheral blood is increasingly utilized to identify biomarkers and pathophysiologic mechanisms of disease. The importance of these platforms in clinical and translational studies led us to investigate the impact of delayed blood processing on the numbers and state of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) and on the plasma proteome. 1162163.name: 10x Multiome from Human Fetal Heart
1162163.title: 10x Multiome from Human Fetal Heart
1162163.description: We hope to uncover the genetic basis of congenital heart disease by examining how genetic variants, especially those in non-coding regions, influence heart development. To achieve this goal, our research team created a single-cell atlas of human fetal heart development. The study population consists of 41 structurally normal fetal hearts spanning 6 to 22 weeks post-conception. 1227601.title: Systemic inflammation and lymphocyte activation precede rheumatoid arthritis
1227601.description: The Allen Institute for Immunology-University of California, San Diego-University of Colorado Transition to Rheumatoid Arthritis (ALTRA) project is a prospective longitudinal cohort study to understand the pre-clinical development of rheumatoid arthritis (RA). 1138808.name: Mutation patterns predict drug response in acute myeloid leukemia
1138808.title: Mutation patterns predict drug response in acute myeloid leukemia
1138808.description: As part of a study correlating co-occurring mutations in Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) with drug sensitivity, we performed single cell mutation analysis to document the subclonal composition for 8 patient samples (blood or marrow mononuclear cells) of the 99 patients studied. 1333510.title: Studies of Atopic Dermatitis through Single-cell Transcriptomics and Immune Repertoires
1333510.description: In atopic dermatitis (AD) patients, the homeostatic processes maintaining barrier integrity and immune regulation in the skin break down, resulting in chronic inflammation. To understand the tissue changes occurring during disease, we profiled skin from AD, scleroderma, and healthy patients using single-cell transcriptomics (scRNA-Seq) and immune repertoire profiling of TCR sequences (scV(D)J-Seq). 1075299.title: Coordinated immune networks in leukemia bone marrow microenvironments distinguish response to cellular therapy
1075299.description: Understanding how intra-tumoral immune populations coordinate to generate anti-tumor responses following therapy can guide precise treatment prioritization. 679098.title: Yale SPORE in Skin Cancer Project 2
679098.description: Understanding the relationship between tumor and peripheral immune environments could allow longitudinal immune monitoring in cancer. However, how diverse cardiac cell types spatially coordinate to create complex morphological structures critical for heart function remains to be elucidated. 1021761.title: Deconvolution of the mechanisms of T cell drug response in multiple myeloma induction therapy
1021761.description: Bortezomib, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone are administered to treat various hematologic malignancies. 895347.title: Clonal dynamics of alloreactive T cells in kidney allograft rejection after anti-PD-1 therapy [Non-naive CD8 single-cell]
895347.description: Kidney transplant recipients are at particular risk for developing tumors, many of which are now routinely treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs); however, ICI therapy can precipitate transplant rejection. 1023366.title: Children's Hospital of Philadelphia  B- and T-cell Acute Leukemia and Lymphomas
1023366.description: Our goal with this study was to identify the mechanisms of treatment resistance in T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) using single-cell genomics. 267621.name: Homo sapiens
267621.title: Single Cell Analysis Program-Transcriptomics (SCAP-T) (UC San Diego site)
267621.description: A comprehensive characterization of transcriptional diversity and heterogeneity of the human cortex is crucial to understand its functions in healthy and disease conditions. The somatic DNA methylation landscape is established early in development, but remains highly dynamic within focal regions that tend to overlap with gene regulatory elements. 1151149.name: Single cell and spatial transcriptomic profiling of Haemophilus ducreyi infection
1151149.title: Single cell and spatial transcriptomic profiling of Haemophilus ducreyi infection
1151149.description: We investigated the immune response in end-point pustules formed by Haemophilus ducreyi in volunteers using an experimental infection model. Six volunteers were infected in the skin of the upper arm at three sites with 41-85 CFU of H. ducreyi loaded on an allergy testing device; a sham-inoculated (e.g., wound) site was also performed. 1014561.title: Immune Responses in Checkpoint Myocarditis Across Heart, Blood, and Tumor
1014561.description: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) are widely used in anti-cancer therapies, but they can cause morbid and potentially fatal immune-related adverse events (irAEs), such as ICI-related myocarditis (irMyocarditis). 1276618.title: Single-cell RNA-seq profiling of peripheral immune responses to severe infection in Uganda

1149847.title: Dynamic evolution of fibroblasts revealed by single cell RNA sequencing of human pancreatic cancer

1321400.name: Single-Cell Analysis of Placenta Development
1321400.title: Single-Cell Analysis of Placenta Development
1321400.description: This study aims to generate a comprehensive, high-resolution understanding of the human maternal-fetal interface across gestation during healthy pregnancy. 1373305.title: Identifying senescence and immune biomarkers predictive of benefit to combined CDK4 and checkpoint blockade inhibition in patients with dedifferentiated liposarcoma

1181949.title: Droplet Hi-C for Fast and Scalable Profiling of Chromatin Architecture in Single Cells

Here we introduce Droplet Hi-C, which uses a commercial microfluidic device for high-throughput, single-cell chromatin conformation profiling in droplets. 610095.title: Molecular characterization of bulk and single cell prostate cancer

850500.title: Single-cell analysis of CD19-specific CAR T cell treatment of relapsed/refractory CD19+ acute lymphoblastic leukemia

1033334.description: Chimeric antigen receptor T cells have transformed the treatment of multiple hematologic malignancies, but are limited in application due to treatment-related toxicities. Cytokine release syndrome (CRS) and neurotoxicity (NT) are the primary toxicities associated with these therapies and are thought to be mediated by broad immune activation due to robust T-cell expansion. 615003.title: CLL relapse after allo-HSCT

1040404.title: Cellular and Molecular Investigations of Human Hearts

To this end, we have performed single-nucleus ATAC-seq on cells derived from 2 human hearts at 15 weeks post conception to define the chromatin profiles and genomic regulatory networks for these in vivo specific cardiomyocyte lineages during development, from which the FASTQ files are available through dbGAP. 1300501.title: Single Nuclei Multiome of the NABEC Cerebral Cortex

1211201.title: Multiomic Landscape of Multiple Myeloma Precursor and Relapsed Disease

Using human renal cortex as the primary tissue, we generated a benchmarking dataset comprising 3' and 5' single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) as well as paired single-nucleus RNA sequencing and chromatin accessibility profiling (snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq). 681647.title: Interdependencies of Intratumoral Genetic Heterogeneity and the Immune Microenvironment in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
681647.description: Tumor microenvironment (TME) and somatic mutations drive progression of chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL). 1024037.title: KRT17High/CXCL8+ tumor cells display both classical and basal features and regulate myeloid infiltration in the pancreatic cancer microenvironment.
1024037.description: Recent studies have uncovered the co-existence of basal and classical subtypes within pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). We sought to characterize these intermediary cells using single-cell RNA sequencing of PDAC. We performed subtyping on 18 single-cell RNA sequencing human PDAC samples to identify multiple intermediary subtypes. 706570.name: Single cell RNA-seq analysis of bronchial epithelium in patients with severe SARS-CoV-2 pneumonia
706570.title: Single cell RNA-seq analysis of bronchial epithelium in patients with severe SARS-CoV-2 pneumonia
706570.description: To test whether airway epithelial and immune cells in patients with severe SARS-CoV-2 pneumonia exhibit specific gene expression signatures (namely interferon-response signature) we have performed bronchoscopy on intubated patients with severe SARS-CoV-2 pneumonia and obtained bronchial brushings. 267620.description: This study aims to assess the technical and biological noise in measured RNA levels in single cells in a number of human tissue types, and to develop analytical tools to address the complexity observed at the single-cell level. 1422192.title: Multi-omics profiling of genetic and transcriptomic alterations in bladder cancer
1422192.description: This prospective study aimed to explore genetic and transcriptomic alterations in bladder cancer using multi-omics approaches. Samples were obtained from clinical investigators under Center for Cancer Research (NCI)_approved protocols, and future submissions will include samples from additional institutions. 1265215.title: Distinct phenotypes and repertoires of bronchoalveolar and airway mucosal T cells in health and allergic asthma
1265215.description: T cells play a central role in host protection against respiratory pathogens, but a maladaptive T cell response can lead to pulmonary diseases. Defining the biology of protective versus pathogenic T cell responses in the lungs of humans will be critical to nominate novel approaches to improve respiratory health. 953149.title: Single-cell ATAC and RNA sequencing of human breast cancer reveals salient cancer-specific enhancers
953149.description: Matched single-cell chromatin accessibility sequencing (scATAC-seq) and single-cell transcriptomic sequencing (scRNA-seq) were performed for 12 human breast tumor samples, 4 normal human mammary reduction samples, and 4 human breast cancer cell lines (HCC1143, SUM149PT, MCF7, and T47D). 1253789.title: HuBMAP: Penn Center for Multi-scale Molecular Mapping of the Female Reproductive System
1253789.description: The female reproductive system, the uterus, fallopian tubes and the ovaries, is a complex interrelated set of organs that is physiologically dynamic and not only important for fertility but critically interrelated with general health. 666164.title: Peanut oral immunotherapy suppresses clonally distinct subsets of T helper cells
666164.description: Food allergy affects an estimated 8% of children in the US, with increasing severity and global prevalence. Using single-cell RNA sequencing and paired TCR sequencing, we assessed the transcriptomes of CD154+ and CD137+ peanut-reactive T helper cells from 12 peanut-allergic patients longitudinally throughout peanut oral immunotherapy. 1181948.title: Droplet Hi-C for Fast and Scalable Profiling of Chromatin Architecture in Single Cells
1181948.description: Current methods for analyzing chromatin architecture are not readily scalable to heterogeneous tissues. Here we introduce Droplet Hi-C, which uses a commercial microfluidic device for high-throughput, single-cell chromatin conformation profiling in droplets. 1010448.title: scRNAseq of Human Urothelial Carcinoma
1010448.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) was performed on urothelial carcinoma samples to investigate the association between squamous differentiation and gene expression. Treatment-naive samples, ranging from Low Grade Ta to High Grade T2, were taken at the time of initial transurethral resection of bladder tumor (TURBT), and scRNA-seq was performed. 1172794.name: HIV DAb-seq of ART-treated individuals
1172794.title: HIV DAb-seq of ART-treated individuals
1172794.description: Despite effective antiretroviral therapy (ART), HIV remains an incurable disease. The latent HIV reservoir is a central obstacle to a cure. It consists of rare CD4+ cells harboring replication-competent proviral DNA that inevitably resumes viremia upon ART interruption. Despite their importance, little is known about the properties of these latently infected CD4+ T-cells. 792849.title: Characterizing the role of the immune microenvironment in multiple myeloma progression at a single cell level
792849.description: The plasma cell disease multiple myeloma (MM) is highly dependent on its bone marrow microenvironment (BMME). 336364.title: Single-cell DNA and RNA sequencing over a 29 year period of a CLL patient demonstrating evolution of multiple cell clones
336364.description: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) is a frequent B-cell malignancy characterized by recurrent somatic chromosome alterations and a low level of point mutations. Here we present single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) microarray analyses of a single CLL patient over 29-years of observation and treatment, and transcriptome and whole genome sequencing at selected timepoints. 935027.title: Single cell colony whole genome sequencing data from individuals with telomere syndromes
935027.description: This is an observational study which examined the phylogenetic evolution of somatic clonal mutations in individuals with Mendelian telomere syndromes. It includes data from two individuals who carry a heterozygous germline POT1 variant, 5 individuals with heterozygous germline mutations in telomerase (TERT or TERC) and one healthy control with normal telomere length. 1185831.title: Longitudinal Multi-omic Immune Resource Reveals Dynamic Responses in Healthy Human Aging
1185831.description: The generation and maintenance of protective immunity is a dynamic interplay between host and environment that is impacted by age. Understanding fundamental changes in the healthy immune system that occur over a lifespan is critical in developing interventions for age-related susceptibility to infections and diseases. 1308652.title: The Sepsis ClinicAl Resource And Biorepository (SCARAB) Project
1308652.description: Bioenergetic dysfunction is an archetypical finding in critical illness, particularly among patients with sepsis. A central feature of sepsis is the shift towards pathologic immunosuppression predisposing to secondary infections and ineffectual organ recovery. 890374.title: Single cell transcriptomic data from CD4+ T cells from children with MIS-C
890374.description: Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C) is a severe complication of SARS-CoV-2 infections in the pediatric population characterized by fever, multi-organ involvement and systemic inflammation. Single-cell RNA sequencing was used to evaluate the transcriptomic signature of CD4+ T cells obtained from the peripheral blood of patients with MIS-C before (n=3) and after (n=5) immunomodulatory treatment, along with pediatric controls (n=4). 1157918.description: Adrenocortical carcinoma (ACC) is a rare endocrine cancer with a poor prognosis for which treatment options are limited. We hypothesized that intratumoral heterogeneity, which has been associated with poor outcomes in other cancers, may play a role in ACC progression and metastasis. 1075331.description: We explored the heterogeneity of lymphocytes in primary human tissues with type 2 inflammation through single cell RNA sequencing. Comparisons of transcriptional profiles were also made with  CD8+ T cells and non-type 2 lymphocytes. 807045.title: Multiplexed scRNA-seq reveals cellular and genetic correlates of SLE
807045.description: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a heterogeneous autoimmune disease. Knowledge of circulating immune cell types and cell states associated with SLE remains incomplete. 951693.description: The immune system is dynamic and changes throughout life, yet molecular cellular details of these changes are not well characterized. 1014565.title: Resistance development in basal cell nevus syndrome through the basal to squamous transition
1014565.description: While basal cell carcinomas (BCCs) arise from ectopic hedgehog pathway activation and can be treated with pathway inhibitors, sporadic BCCs display high resistance rates, while tumors arising in Gorlin syndrome patients with germline Patched (PTCH1) mutations are uniformly suppressed by inhibitor therapy. 684640.title: Identification and characterization of skin-resident memory T cells in patients with melanoma-associated vitiligo

1246417.title: Peptide Driven Identification of TCRs (PDI-TCR) reveals dynamics and phenotypes of CD4 T cells in tuberculosis
1246417.description: Accurately assigning antigen specificity to T cell receptor (TCR) sequences is challenging due to the complexity of the TCR-antigen recognition process in humans. We developed the Peptide-Driven Identification of TCRs (PDI-TCR) assay, a novel method combining in vitro expansion with peptide pools, bulk TCR sequencing, and statistical analysis to identify antigen-specific TCRs from human blood. 609094.name: single cell RNA-seq analysis of ovarian cancer ascites
609094.title: single cell RNA-seq analysis of ovarian cancer ascites
609094.description: To understand the cellular diversity within malignant ascites, we profiled ~11,000 single cells from 22 samples by Smartseq2 and by 10x. Overall design: Ascites samples were either depleted of CD45+ cells and profiled by 10x or sorted by EPCAM+CD24+ and profiled by SmartSeq2 Note from Submitter: We have difficulties in approving raw data submission of data from clinical patient samples to GEO or dbGAP and are therefore submitting at this point only the processed data and the metadata.  In parall

995801.name: The origin and dynamics of cellular heterogeneity vary across lineage subtypes of castrate resistant prostate cancer [scATAC-seq]
995801.title: The origin and dynamics of cellular heterogeneity vary across lineage subtypes of castrate resistant prostate cancer [scATAC-seq]
995801.description: Cancer cells often adapt a stem-like state resulting in lineage plasticity and phenotypic heterogeneity. We assessed the dynamics of lineage determination and cellular subpopulation expansion in treatment-resistant adenocarcinoma, amphicrine, and small cell neuroendocrine castrate resistant prostate cancers. 1333508.name: Studies of Atopic Dermatitis through Single-cell Transcriptomics and Immune Repertoires
1333508.title: Studies of Atopic Dermatitis through Single-cell Transcriptomics and Immune Repertoires
1333508.description: In atopic dermatitis (AD) patients, the homeostatic processes maintaining barrier integrity and immune regulation in the skin break down, resulting in chronic inflammation. To understand the tissue changes occurring during disease, we profiled skin from AD, scleroderma, and healthy patients using single-cell transcriptomics (scRNA-Seq) and immune repertoire profiling of TCR sequences (scV(D)J-Seq). 1308651.name: The Sepsis ClinicAl Resource And Biorepository (SCARAB) Project
1308651.title: The Sepsis ClinicAl Resource And Biorepository (SCARAB) Project
1308651.description: Bioenergetic dysfunction is an archetypical finding in critical illness, particularly among patients with sepsis. A central feature of sepsis is the shift towards pathologic immunosuppression predisposing to secondary infections and ineffectual organ recovery. 893807.name: Whole-genome sequencing analysis of extrachromosomal DNA with Amplicon Architect
893807.title: Whole-genome sequencing analysis of extrachromosomal DNA with Amplicon Architect

787953.name: Multi-modal single-cell sequencing identifies cellular immunophenotypes associated with juvenile dermatomyositis disease activity
787953.title: Multi-modal single-cell sequencing identifies cellular immunophenotypes associated with juvenile dermatomyositis disease activity
787953.description: Juvenile dermatomyositis (JDM) is a rare autoimmune condition with insufficient biomarkers and treatments, in part, due to incomplete knowledge of the cell types mediating disease. We investigated immunophenotypes and cell-specific genes associated with disease activity using multiplexed RNA and protein single-cell sequencing applied to PBMCs from 4 treatment-naïve JDM (TN-JDM) subjects at baseline, 2, 4, and 6 months and 4 subjects with inactive disease. 841973.title: Droplet-based bisulfite sequencing for high-throughput profiling of single-cell DNA methylomes
841973.description: We present a high-throughput and droplet-based bisulfite sequencing library preparation platform. Our protocol allows production of BS library of 2,000-10,000 single cells within 2 days. In addition to validation using mixed cell lines, we also used the technology to profile various cell types in mouse and human brain samples. 551048.title: Single cell RNA-seq of BRAF-rearranged pilocytic astrocytomas
551048.description: Pilocytic astrocytoma (PA), the most common childhood brain tumor, is a low-grade glioma with a single driver BRAF rearrangement. Here, we perform scRNAseq in six PAs using methods that enabled detection of the rearrangement. When compared to higher-grade gliomas, a strikingly higher proportion of the PA cancer cells exhibit a differentiated, astrocyte-like phenotype. 649150.name: Circuits between infected macrophages and T cells in SARS-CoV-2 pneumonia
649150.title: Circuits between infected macrophages and T cells in SARS-CoV-2 pneumonia
649150.description: Some patients infected with Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) develop severe pneumonia and the acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). Distinct clinical features in these patients have led to speculation that the immune response to virus in the SARS-CoV-2-infected alveolus differs from other types of pneumonia. 1259076.title: Cellular profiling identifies targetable T cell phenotypes in lymphocytic variant hypereosinophilic syndrome
1259076.description: Lymphocytic variant hypereosinophilic syndrome (LHES) is driven by aberrant Th2_skewed lymphocyte clones that promote tissue eosinophilia. We performed multimodal single_cell RNA_sequencing (scRNA_seq), cell_surface protein (ADT) profiling, and paired alphabeta_TCR sequencing on peripheral_blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from two clinically characterized LHES patients and one idiopathic HES control. 967336.name: MAITs in HCC
967336.title: MAITs in HCC
967336.description: Here we investigate the role of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells in human and murine hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). We isolated immune cells of syngeneic HCC cell line RIL-175 tumor-bearing or tumor-free livers and applied FACS sorting (CD45+ leukocytes) prior to 10X genomics based scRNA-seq. 640201.name: Genomic Profiling of Hematologic Disorders
640201.title: Genomic Profiling of Hematologic Disorders
640201.description: Myeloid malignancies have previously been characterized by large scale bulk molecular profiling studies on patient samples. These studies, while clinically informative, are unable to delineate mutation order as well as clonal architecture and complexity. To investigate the clonal framework of myeloid malignancies, the Single Cell Mutational Profiling in Myeloid Malignancies study was designed. This study performed sequencing of 148 samples from 117 adult patients diagnosed with clonal hematopoie

1306684.name: HEAL PRECISION: Human Nociceptor and Spinal Cord Molecular Signature Center
1306684.title: HEAL PRECISION: Human Nociceptor and Spinal Cord Molecular Signature Center
1306684.description: The goal of this research project is to create a scientific foundation that will inform novel pain therapeutics, by forming a deeper understanding of the molecular characteristics of the human pain pathways. By studying human dorsal root ganglion (DRG), we aim to identify the mechanisms that cause chronic pain. Firstly, our Center will use single cell and spatial transcriptomic technologies on human sensory neurons from tissues recovered from both organ donors and patients enduring chronic pain

300464.title: Fixed single-cell transcriptomic characterization of human radial glial diversity
300464.description: The human neocortex is created from diverse intermixed progenitors in the prenatal germinal zones. These progenitors have been difficult to characterize since progenitors - particularly radial glia (RG) - are rare, and are defined by a combination of intracellular markers, position and morphology. To circumvent these problems we developed a method called FRISCR for transcriptome profiling of individual fixed, stained and sorted cells. 823695.name: Melanoma Brain Metastasis Atlas [single-cell/nuclei RNA-sequencing (sc/snRNA-seq)]
823695.title: Melanoma Brain Metastasis Atlas [single-cell/nuclei RNA-sequencing (sc/snRNA-seq)]
823695.description: We performed single-cell/nuclei RNA-sequencing (sc/snRNA-seq) of 22 treatment-naïve melanoma brain metastases (MBM; 5 samples using scRNA-seq and 17 snRNA-seq) from 21 patients and 10 treatment-naïve extracranial (peripheral) metastases (MPM; all snRNA-seq) from 10 patients . 993797.name: Targeted linked-read DNA-seq analysis of castration-resistant prostate cancers
993797.title: Targeted linked-read DNA-seq analysis of castration-resistant prostate cancers
993797.description: Androgen receptor (AR) inhibition is standard of care for advanced prostate cancer (PC). However, its efficacy is limited by progression to castration-resistant PC (CRPC), usually due to AR re-activation via mechanisms that include AR amplification and structural rearrangement. 671295.title: HuBMAP: A 3-D Tissue Map of the Human Lymphatic System
671295.description: The major goal of the 3-D Tissue Map of the Human Lymphatic System is to use microscopic and biomolecular procedures to facilitate co-registration pipelines and common 3D reconstruction algorithms. Tissue collected from human spleen, thymus and lymph node will be spatially resolved at the single cell level both within and across individuals. The approach employed involves sequencing of transcriptomes of dissociated cells and mapping to histological sections using CO-Detection by indEXing (CODEX)

1276164.name: INCLUDE: Down syndrome early post-natal basal forebrain multiome
1276164.title: INCLUDE: Down syndrome early post-natal basal forebrain multiome
1276164.description: Neurodevelopmental deficiencies and neuronal dysfunction contribute to cognitive impairment in individuals with Down syndrome, but what molecular pathways underlie the defects that lead to intellectual disability remain unclear. 1312893.name: Exome and multi-site bulk and scRNA-seq profiling of pleural mesothelioma
1312893.title: Exome and multi-site bulk and scRNA-seq profiling of pleural mesothelioma
1312893.description: This study comprehensively profiles pleural mesothelioma (PM) using integrated bulk DNA sequencing [whole-exome sequencing (WES)], bulk RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq), single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq), optical genome mapping, spatial transcriptomics, and spatial proteomics. 1023686.title: Circulating Genomic Determinants of Treatment Failure in Hodgkin Lymphoma

1227599.title: Single cell and spatial transcriptomics studies of Fibrosis in Prospective Registry in IBD Study at MGH and GI Disease and Endoscopy Registry
1227599.description: Stricturing disease or fibrosis is a common complication of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), often requiring surgical intervention. 1281733.title: Pyoderma gangrenosum caused by molecular uncoupling of OTULIN catalytic activity and LUBAC binding
1281733.description: This is a single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) study using peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) from 3 healthy donors and 2 patients with OTULIN-related Pyoderma Gangrenosum (ORP). 1373311.title: Well plate lineage sequencing for ultra-high-quality SNV and indel detection with single cell cycle resolution in vitro
1373311.description: Lineage sequencing uniquely measures somatic single nucleotide variants in dividing cells to achieve high specificity/sensitivity as well as the ability to temporally resolve variants and to relate sequenced genotypes to optically observed cellular phenotypes. 810346.title: A Novel MIP-1 Expressing Macrophage Subtype in Bronchoalveolar Lavage Fluid from Healthy Volunteers

762948.title: Maintenance of Genome Sequence Integrity in Long -and Short-lived Rodent Species
762948.description: In this study, we compared somatic mutation frequencies and spectra of bleomycin-treated and control fibroblasts of 5 species, i.e., mouse, guinea pig, blind mole-rat, naked mole-rat and humans, by using single-cell whole-genome sequencing. Sequencing data of the human cells are deposited here in the dbGaP. Sequencing data of the rodent cells are in the SRA database, under accession ID: PRJNA753541.

Genomic studies indicate it is often a small subpopulation rather than the dominant population in the FL that gives rise to the more aggressive subtype. 1005705.title: T Cells Expressing a Novel Fully-Human Anti-BCMA CAR for Treating Multiple Myeloma
1005705.description: Patients with relapsed multiple myeloma were treated with fully-human heavy-chain-only CAR T cells (FHVH-T) targeting B-cell Maturation Antigen (BCMA), a protein expressed by multiple myeloma cells. 946019.title: Analysis of donor pancreata defines the transcriptomic signature and microenvironment of early neoplastic pancreatic lesions.
946019.description: The adult healthy human pancreas has been poorly studied given lack of indication to obtain tissue from the pancreas in the absence of disease and rapid postmortem degradation. We obtained pancreata from brain dead donors thus avoiding any warm ischemia time. 671483.title: Transcriptomic and clonal characterization of T-cells in the human central nervous system
671483.description: The cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is thought to be a main route for immune surveillance in the central nervous system (CNS). Understanding the composition and state of CSF in healthy individuals may provide insight into perturbations present during neuroinflammation. Here, we have used single-cell RNA and TCR sequencing to profile CSF and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from healthy individuals and patients with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (MS), a chronic autoimmmune disease. 1101984.title: Type 2 Diabetes Specific Spatial Differential Gene Expression in Pancreas Visium Data
1101984.description: Understanding the spatial distribution of gene expression in the pancreas could provide new insights into its function and islet biology. Visium spatial gene expression is a powerful tool for quantifying gene expression of cells within their spatial context. 1157919.description: Adrenocortical carcinoma (ACC) is a rare endocrine cancer with a poor prognosis for which treatment options are limited. We hypothesized that intratumoral heterogeneity, which has been associated with poor outcomes in other cancers, may play a role in ACC progression and metastasis. 679644.title: Development of tools for cell-type specific labeling of neocortical neurons
679644.description: A complete epigenomic map of human brain cell types will be necessary to fully understand their genetic regulation, and to create the next generation of non-species-restricted genetic tools for their functional characterization. 1294240.title: Neuronal-Activity Dependent Mechanisms of Small Cell Lung Cancer Pathogenesis

In the brain, neuronal activity robustly influences glioma growth both through paracrine mechanisms and through electrochemical integration of malignant cells into neural circuitry via neuron-to-glioma synapses. 1276617.title: Single-cell RNA-seq profiling of peripheral immune responses to severe infection in Uganda
1276617.description: We conducted a prospective observational study (RESERVE-U-2-TOR) of adults admitted to Tororo General Hospital in eastern Uganda with severe, undifferentiated infection (i.e., suspected sepsis). 1107270.title: B cell directed CAR-T cell therapy results in activation of CD8+ cytotoxic CAR-negative bystander T cells in both non-human primates and patients (human)
1107270.description: There is growing appreciation for the emergence of CARneg bystander T cells after CAR-T cell infusion. 842223.title: Multi-modal skin atlas associates a multicellular immune-stromal community with altered cornification and T cell expansion in atopic dermatitis [scRNAseq_VDJ]

890375.title: Single cell transcriptomic data from CD4+ T cells from children with MIS-C
890375.description: Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C) is a severe complication of SARS-CoV-2 infections in the pediatric population characterized by fever, multi-organ involvement and systemic inflammation. 1078932.title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals discrete tumour microenvironments and autocrine loops within ovarian cancer subclones
1078932.description: Ovarian masses from patients with high grade serous ovarian carcinoma undergoing debulking surgery were subjected to spatial transcriptomics profiling using the 10x Genomics Visium (fresh frozen) platform. 671321.name: HuBMAP Single-Cell Data from Human Tissues
671321.title: HuBMAP Single-Cell Data from Human Tissues
671321.description: The small bowel and colon are organs critical for maintaining homeostasis of the human body by mediating nutritional absorption upon the ingestion of food. 1009671.title: Single-cell  transcription and chromatin accessbility profiles of IDH mutant gliomas
1009671.description: we use single cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq to understand the cell states and epigenetic states of IDH mutant gliomas, including the condition with DNMT1 inhibitor treatment Overall design: Primary IDH mutant glioma samples  are collected after surgery and used for the establishment of organoid. 609183.title: A single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-Seq toolbox for fresh and frozen human tumors
609183.description: Single cell transcriptomics is a powerful tool to map the complex tumor microenvironment, providing unprecedented resolution into cell types, cell states, cell interactions, and tumor heterogeneity. 660743.title: Transcriptomic and clonal characterization of T cells in the human central nervous system
660743.description: Tissues develop unique homeostatic immune states through specific recruitment of immune cells that are further shaped by the tissue environment. 587118.title: Single-cell analysis reveals new evolutionary complexity in uveal melanoma
587118.description: Uveal melanoma (UM) is a highly metastatic cancer that, in contrast to cutaneous melanoma, is largely unresponsive to checkpoint immunotherapy. In this study we interrogate the tumour microenvironment at single-cell resolution using scRNA-seq of 59,915 tumour and non-neoplastic cells from 8 primary and 3 metastatic samples. 430902.name: Single cell RNA-seq analysis of freshly isolated synovial fibroblasts in patients with rheumatoid arthritis or osteoarthritis
430902.title: Single cell RNA-seq analysis of freshly isolated synovial fibroblasts in patients with rheumatoid arthritis or osteoarthritis
430902.description: Transcriptomics of distinct subpopulations of synovial fibroblasts from osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis arthroplasty tissues.
