1305033.title: Functional and dysfunctional T regulatory cell states in human tissues in RA and other autoimmune arthritic diseases
1305033.description: This study includes newly generated regulatory T cell datasets derived from peripheral blood and synovial fluid samples obtained from adult patients with rheumatoid arthritis. These samples were collected and processed for flow cytometry and single-cell transcriptomic analyses. Additional datasets analyzed in the associated manuscript, including synovial tissue and healthy donor blood samples, were obtained from previously published public repositories and are not part of this dbGaP deposition.

999323.name: SARS-CoV-2 infection elucidates unique features of pregnancy-specific immunity [GEX]
999323.title: SARS-CoV-2 infection elucidates unique features of pregnancy-specific immunity [GEX]
999323.description: Pregnancy is a risk factor for increased severity of SARS-CoV-2 and other respiratory infections. 859193.name: Single-Cell Profiling of Premature Neonate Airways Reveals a Continuum of Myeloid Differentiation
859193.title: Single-Cell Profiling of Premature Neonate Airways Reveals a Continuum of Myeloid Differentiation
859193.description: Single-cell genomic technologies hold great potential to advance our understanding of lung development and disease. A major limitation lies in accessing intact cells from primary lung tissues for profiling human airway health. 664057.title: Lung transplantation for patients with severe COVID-19
664057.description: Lung transplantation can potentially be a life-saving treatment for patients with non-resolving COVID-19-associated respiratory failure. Concerns limiting transplant include recurrence of SARS-CoV-2 infection in the allograft, technical challenges imposed by viral-mediated injury to the native lung, and potential risk for allograft infection by pathogens associated with ventilator-associated pneumonia in the native lung. 1373313.title: RNAseq of human nasal epithelial cultures infected with rhinovirus
1373313.description: Rhinovirus (RV) is the most frequent cause of common colds, but also a major cause of serious respiratory illness in high-risk groups (e.g., smokers and asthmatics). 811185.name: Multi-omics analyses of changes in the tumor microenvironment of pancreatic adenocarcinoma following neoadjuvant treatment with anti-PD-1 antibody
811185.title: Multi-omics analyses of changes in the tumor microenvironment of pancreatic adenocarcinoma following neoadjuvant treatment with anti-PD-1 antibody
811185.description: Successful pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) immunotherapy necessitates optimization and maintenance of activated effector T cells (Teffs). We prospectively collected and applied multi-omics analysis to paired, pre- and post-treatment PDAC specimens collected in a platform neoadjuvant study of GVAX vaccine +/- nivolumab (anti-PD-1) to uncover sensitivity and resistance mechanisms. 1281738.name: B cell lymphocytosis and reprogramming due to a CARD11 bi-allelic gain-of-function mutation
1281738.title: B cell lymphocytosis and reprogramming due to a CARD11 bi-allelic gain-of-function mutation
1281738.description: This is a single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) study using peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) from 2 healthy donors and 2 patients with B cell Expansion with NF-_B and T cell Anergy (BENTA). 981556.title: Single cell RNAseq of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from children with mitochondrial disease
981556.description: Mitochondria are nearly ubiquitous in all cells, suggesting that mitochondrial dysfunction may extend to the immune system.  In this study, we utilized Single-Cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) to characterize cellular heterogeneity and the pathologic underpinnings of mitochondrial disease in peripheral blood mononuclear cells from pediatric patients. 895089.title: Decoding the endometrial niche of Asherman's syndrome at single-cell resolution [organoids]
895089.description: Asherman’s Syndrome is characterized by intrauterine adhesions or scarring, which cause infertility, menstrual abnormalities, and recurrent pregnancy loss. 962196.name: Genetic analysis of skin cells
962196.title: Genetic analysis of skin cells
962196.description: Cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) is a form of skin cancer originating from keratinocytes in the skin. They have high mutation burdens, primarily driven by UV-radiation-induced DNA damage. The order in which mutations undergo selection during the evolution of cSCC is not known. 734667.title: Tissue and Fluid Analysis in Ocular Inflammatory Disease

728702.title: Multiplexed scRNA-seq reveals the cellular and genetic correlates of systemic lupus erythematosus
728702.description: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a heterogeneous autoimmune disease. Knowledge of circulating immune cell types and cell states associated with SLE remains incomplete. 768495.title: The Spatio-Temporal Evolution of Multiple Myeloma from Baseline to Relapse-Refractory States
768495.description: In multiple myeloma, the spatio-temporal evolution patterns of cancer cells in the bone marrow remain largely unknown. Here, we applied spatial-longitudinal sequencing, including a total of 179 samples collected from 25 patients during a follow-up of up to 14 years. 552370.name: Single-cell connectomic analysis of adult mammalian lungs
552370.title: Single-cell connectomic analysis of adult mammalian lungs
552370.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq) has made it possible to analyze complex organs such as the lung with unprecedented resolution. We have leveraged these techniques to identify conserved patterns of cell-cell cross-talk in adult mammalian lungs, analyzing mouse, rat, pig and human pulmonary tissues. 987021.title: Microvascular Permeability, Inflammation, and Lesion Physiology in Endometriosis: A Microphysiological Systems Approach

1254327.title: Human Body Single-Cell Atlas of 3D Genome Organization and DNA Methylation
1254327.description: Cell type specific patterns of gene expression arise from an interplay of diverse gene regulatory mechanisms, including transcription factor binding, chromatin accessibility, DNA methylation, and higher-order chromatin organization. 972295.title: Comparative single-cell analyses identify shared and divergent features of human and mouse kidney development [human snRNA-seq]

679643.title: Development of tools for cell-type specific labeling of neocortical neurons

1438241.title: Multi-modal profiling reveals epithelial hierarchy disorganization underlying field cancerization in head and neck cancer
1438241.description: Local recurrence rates in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) exceed 50%, potentially due to field cancerization, a phenomenon where tissue that appears normal microscopically actually harbors molecular changes that can give rise to new tumors. 1133820.description: Immune aging is a dynamic process shaped by time and external perturbation. 498740.title: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma human organoids share structural and genetic features with primary tumors

484965.title: Altered oligodendrocyte heterogeneity in Multiple sclerosis.

Additional datasets analyzed in the associated manuscript, including synovial tissue and healthy donor blood samples, were obtained from previously published public repositories and are not part of this dbGaP deposition.

989355.title: Uveal Melanoma Immunogenomics Predict Immunotherapy Resistance and Susceptibility

862872.description: Single-cell multi-omic datasets, in which multiple molecular modalities are profiled within the same cell, provide a unique opportunity to discover the interplay between cellular epigenomic and transcriptomic changes. 1253785.description: People living with HIV (PLWH) are at the higher risk for impaired cognitive functions such as HIV-Associated Neurocognitive Disorder or HAND. 1244939.title: Neurogenetic studies of trichotillomania and excoriation disorder
1244939.description: The overall objective of this study is to use a series of state-of-the-art neurogenetic approaches to advance our understanding of the genes and pathways that contribute to trichotillomania and excoriation disorder. In aim 1, we will use whole-exome DNA sequencing to examine rare sequence variants in 200 parent-child trios where the child has trichotillomania or excoriation disorder. 1311158.name: Space Associated Stem Cell Hallmarks of Aging in Astronauts
1311158.title: Space Associated Stem Cell Hallmarks of Aging in Astronauts
1311158.description: This study examined the effects of the stress of space, specifically low earth orbit, on hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) that maintain lifelong hematopoiesis and immune responses. Enriched CD34+ HSPCs were derived from 9 astronauts before, during and after 10 and 21-day ISS missions on the International Space Station. The samples were used as input to whole transcriptome sequencing by bulk RNA-Seq performed at The Scripps Research Institute Next Generation Sequencing Core on an I

1288048.name: Numbat-multiome: Inferring copy number variation by combining RNA and chromatin accessibility information from single-cell data
1288048.title: Numbat-multiome: Inferring copy number variation by combining RNA and chromatin accessibility information from single-cell data
1288048.description: Numbat-multiome is a computational framework designed to infer copy number variations (CNVs) by integrating RNA and chromatin accessibility data from single-cell multiomic datasets. The methodology extends the original Numbat tool, enhancing its capabilities by incorporating scATAC-seq-derived allelic imbalance information, primarily from regulatory, non-coding genomic regions. 789262.name: A comprehensive platform for analyzing longitudinal multi-omics data
789262.title: A comprehensive platform for analyzing longitudinal multi-omics data
789262.description: We profiled four healthy individuals with age between 25 to 38 years old over 10-week period longitudinally using high throughput analysis. We measured blood count, flow-based cell populations, plasma proteome, transcriptome at single cell level, and genomic region accessibility using single cell ATAC to infer immune variations in healthy individuals. Overall design: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells from 4 healthy individuals were profiled using multi-modal single cell RNAseq and scATACseq usi

287184.name: Melanoma Exome Sequencing
287184.title: Melanoma Exome Sequencing
287184.description: This study reports on genomic profiling [whole-exome sequencing (WXS), bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq), and/or single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq)] of patient-derived melanoma samples and matched normal samples. The goal is to elucidate the genetic and cellular basis of sun-exposed and sun-shielded melanomas and to relate these findings to survival and regional metastasis. Specimens were collected by the Tissue Resource Core of the Yale SPORE in Skin Cancer with participants' informed signed co

671264.name: Single Cell Genomic Analysis of Lymphoma
671264.title: Single Cell Genomic Analysis of Lymphoma
671264.description: Our studies aimed to define the extent of heterogeneity between anatomically separated tumor manifestations and to identify treatment-induced changes in patients with indolent lymphoma, mainly follicular lymphoma, enrolled in in situ vaccinations trials at single-cell resolution. We subjected single-cell suspensions collected from nodal, synchronously-acquired fine needle aspirations from two distinct tumor sites over time to high-throughput microfluidics-based single-cell RNA sequencing. 1024040.name: Basal-to-inflammatory transition contributes to basal cell carcinoma therapy resistance via crosstalk with a pro-inflammatory stromal niche
1024040.title: Basal-to-inflammatory transition contributes to basal cell carcinoma therapy resistance via crosstalk with a pro-inflammatory stromal niche
1024040.description: Overcoming tumor evolution and inducible resistance states remain the main challenge to creating successful anti-tumor therapies. The body's cancer-associated inflammatory response is a double-edged sword having ill-defined pro- and anti-tumor properties. Our group previously identified a basal cell carcinoma (BCC) tumor-intrinsic resistance pathway called basal to squamous cell carcinoma transition (BST). However, tumor resistance driven through the complex dynamics of tumor interactions with t

727873.name: Integrative molecular characterization of breast cancer
727873.title: Integrative molecular characterization of breast cancer
727873.description: Version 1: We have performed integrative analyses of breast cancer tumors, including whole exome sequencing (WES) of tumor and normal pairs, whole transcriptome sequencing, and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) or single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq), to determine molecular correlates of response to novel and immune therapies. We have focused on dissecting the role of anticancer immunity in response to these therapies and understanding biological mechanisms underlying therapeutic resis

1256938.name: High-resolution single cell profiling of SARS-CoV-2 vaccine responsiveness in healthy adults
1256938.title: High-resolution single cell profiling of SARS-CoV-2 vaccine responsiveness in healthy adults
1256938.description: mRNA vaccines, administered in two doses, have been highly effective against SARS-CoV-2 and are now being explored for broader applications. However, how human immune cells respond to these platforms, particularly differences between primary and booster responses, remains incompletely understood. 338827.name: Homo sapiens
338827.title: The Finland-United States Investigation of NIDDM Genetics (FUSION) Study – Islet Expression and Regulation by RNAseq and ATACseq
338827.description: This study evaluates gene expression and its regulation in human pancreatic islets, a tissue relevant in the study of genetic risk factors contributing to diabetes. We obtained pancreatic tissue sections and purified pancreatic islets from deceased donors and processed these biological samples to generate various data types. We generated spatial transcriptomic data from pancreatic tissue samples using the 10X Genomics VISIUM technology with sequencing on the Illumina NovaSeq platform. We also ge

794245.name: Single-cell analysis of Somatic Mutations in Human Bronchial Epithelial Cells in Relation to Aging and Smoking
794245.title: Single-cell analysis of Somatic Mutations in Human Bronchial Epithelial Cells in Relation to Aging and Smoking
794245.description: While lung cancer risk among smokers is dependent on smoking dose, it remains unknown if this increased risk reflects an increased rate of somatic mutation accumulation in normal lung cells. Here we applied single-cell whole genome sequencing of proximal bronchial basal cells from 33 subjects, aged between 11 and 86 years, with smoking histories varying from never smoking to 116 pack years. We found an increase in the frequency of single-nucleotide variants and small insertions and deletions wit

1399487.name: Systematic evaluation of single-cell multimodal data integration for comprehensive human reference atlas
1399487.title: Systematic evaluation of single-cell multimodal data integration for comprehensive human reference atlas
1399487.description: We systematically evaluated experimental and computational strategies for integrating multimodal single-cell and single-nucleus genomics data in complex human tissues. Using human renal cortex as the primary tissue, we generated a benchmarking dataset comprising 3' and 5' single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) as well as paired single-nucleus RNA sequencing and chromatin accessibility profiling (snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq). Samples were obtained from healthy adult donors undergoing nephrectomy, re

1148227.name: Single Cell RNA-sequencing of BCG naïve and recurrent non-muscle invasive bladder cancer reveals a CD6/ALCAM-mediated immune-suppressive pathway
1148227.title: Single Cell RNA-sequencing of BCG naïve and recurrent non-muscle invasive bladder cancer reveals a CD6/ALCAM-mediated immune-suppressive pathway
1148227.description: Non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) represents 70_80% patients with newly diagnosed bladder cancer, and Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) remains a cornerstone treatment for intermediate- and high-risk NMIBC to prevent disease recurrence and progression. However, a significant number of patients experience recurrence after their first course of BCG, posing significant challenges in the management of the disease. We conducted single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-Seq) on freshly collected NMIBC s

971189.name: Single cell transcriptomics reveals cell type specific features of developmentally regulated responses to lipopolysaccharide between birth and 5 years
971189.title: Single cell transcriptomics reveals cell type specific features of developmentally regulated responses to lipopolysaccharide between birth and 5 years
971189.description: Perinatal life is a period of extraordinary change in which newborns transition into a new world abundant in environmental stimuli and pathogens.  To meet this challenge, the neonatal immune system is equipped with unique functional characteristics and is subject to ongoing development across the early childhood years. To investigate differences in innate immune transcriptional responses, we applied scRNA-Seq to analyze blood collected at birth and 5 years of age following stimulation with two w

929450.name: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Phase III Trial Evaluating Motixafortide and G-CSF to Mobilize Hematopoietic Stem Cells for Autologous Transplantation in Multiple Myeloma – The Genesis Trial
929450.title: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Phase III Trial Evaluating Motixafortide and G-CSF to Mobilize Hematopoietic Stem Cells for Autologous Transplantation in Multiple Myeloma – The Genesis Trial
929450.description: Autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (ASCT) improves survival in multiple myeloma (MM). However, up to 30% of MM patients are unable to collect optimal numbers of peripheral blood (PB) CD34+ hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) with standard G-CSF mobilization. Motixafortide is a novel cyclic-peptide CXCR4 inhibitor with extended receptor occupancy and enhanced in-vivo activity. 781748.name: Hematopoiesis at single cell resolution spanning human development and maturation
781748.title: Hematopoiesis at single cell resolution spanning human development and maturation
781748.description: Hematopoiesis is a process of constitutive regeneration whereby hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) constantly replenish mature blood cells. During maturation and aging, HSPCs alter their output to support the shifting demands of prenatal development and postnatal maturation both at homeostasis and in response to stress. How HSPC ontogeny changes throughout life is unknown; studies to date have largely focused on analysis of specific individual ages, particularly those done at single

672734.name: Single-cell RNA Sequencing data from PBMC subjected to whole blood processing delay
672734.title: Single-cell RNA Sequencing data from PBMC subjected to whole blood processing delay
672734.description: Multi-omic profiling of human peripheral blood is increasingly utilized to identify biomarkers and pathophysiologic mechanisms of disease. The importance of these platforms in clinical and translational studies led us to investigate the impact of delayed blood processing on the numbers and state of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) and on the plasma proteome. Similar to previous studies, we show minimal effects of delayed processing on the numbers and general phenotype of PBMCs up to 18

733527.name: Single cell 'omics resolves transcriptional alterations in Sjogren's Syndrome
733527.title: Single cell 'omics resolves transcriptional alterations in Sjogren's Syndrome
733527.description: This data compares the single cell transcriptional profiles of the minor salivary glands and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) between patients diagnosed with Sjogren's Disease (SjD) and those who do not meet criteria (non-Sjogren's Disease). Portions of this data were reported in two separate publications: Huang & Perez, et al., 2021 Nature Medicine and Yin, et al., 2021, Frontiers in Immunology, although not originally analyzed together. 895336.name: Clonal dynamics of alloreactive T cells in kidney allograft rejection after anti-PD-1 therapy [MLR single-cell]
895336.title: Clonal dynamics of alloreactive T cells in kidney allograft rejection after anti-PD-1 therapy [MLR single-cell]
895336.description: Kidney transplant recipients are at particular risk for developing tumors, many of which are now routinely treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs); however, ICI therapy can precipitate transplant rejection. We utilized TCR sequencing to identify and track alloreactive T cells in a patient with melanoma who experienced kidney transplant rejection following ICI therapy. 954960.name: Remodeling of the immune system across human lifespan at single cell resolution
954960.title: Remodeling of the immune system across human lifespan at single cell resolution
954960.description: The immune system is dynamic and changes throughout life, yet molecular/cellular details of these changes are not well characterized. To precisely characterize age and sex associated changes in peripheral immune cells throughout lifespan, we profiled >600K cells from 95 samples from four age groups: infants (n=27, 2-18 months old), children (n=23), young adults (n=18), and older adults (n=27, 65-90+ years old) using single cell RNA-seq. 954961.name: Remodeling of the immune system across human lifespan at single cell resolution
954961.title: Remodeling of the immune system across human lifespan at single cell resolution
954961.description: The immune system is dynamic and changes throughout life, yet molecular/cellular details of these changes are not well characterized. To precisely characterize age and sex associated changes in peripheral immune cells throughout lifespan, we profiled >600K cells from 95 samples from four age groups: infants (n=27, 2-18 months old), children (n=23), young adults (n=18), and older adults (n=27, 65-90+ years old) using single cell RNA-seq. CD8+ T cells were the most affected with age, where naive T

1311167.name: Single-cell multiomics of the immune microenvironment in T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
1311167.title: Single-cell multiomics of the immune microenvironment in T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
1311167.description: We present single-cell transcriptome and surface protein expression (CITE-seq) data from four healthy donors and fifteen pediatric T cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL) patients at diagnosis and at different treatment timepoints (days 1 _ 6 and at time of remission). Mononuclear cells from peripheral blood (PB; longitudinal) or bone marrow (BM; diagnosis only) were isolated and CD45high immune cells and CD45dimCD7+ malignant cells were sorted and subsequently pooled to enrich for immune ce

693011.name: Single Cell Analysis of Chromatin Accessibility Reveals Genetic and Regulatory Heterogeneity in Glioblastomas
693011.title: Single Cell Analysis of Chromatin Accessibility Reveals Genetic and Regulatory Heterogeneity in Glioblastomas
693011.description: Intra-tumoral heterogeneity is a key contributor to therapeutic failure in glioblastomas, the most common form of primary adult brain cancer.  To better define this heterogeneity, genome-wide chromatin accessibility and transcription profiles of clinical glioblastoma specimens were analyzed at single cell resolution. These profiles afforded resolution of intra-tumoral genetic heterogeneity and delineation of sub-populations characterized by focal DNA amplifications including extrachromosomal cir

856475.name: Single-cell RNA-Seq resolves phenotypically heterogeneous subtypes in systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis (SJIA)
856475.title: Single-cell RNA-Seq resolves phenotypically heterogeneous subtypes in systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis (SJIA)
856475.description: Systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis (SJIA) is a clinically heterogenous systemic inflammatory disorder sometimes complicated by macrophage activation syndrome (MAS) and lung disease (LD), which are thought to be driven by IFN signaling. To identify cellular sources and novel gene programs underlying SJIA pathogenesis, we performed the first in-depth single-cell RNA Sequencing (scRNA-Seq) analysis of 21 SJIA, SJIA-LD, and SJIA-MAS patient PBMCs. 1276619.name: Genomic copy-number variants drive apoptotic resistance and relapses on immune checkpoint inhibitors
1276619.title: Genomic copy-number variants drive apoptotic resistance and relapses on immune checkpoint inhibitors
1276619.description: We investigated the genomic mechanisms underlying acquired resistance (AR) to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) across tumor types, specifically by examining how copy number variant (CNV)-driven subclonal evolution contributes to clinical relapses in melanoma patients. We analyzed longitudinal clinical melanoma samples from patients who experienced relapses on ICI therapy, complemented by isogenic human melanoma cell line models (M486) and murine melanoma tumor systems. Single-cell whole-genom

1263045.name: Uncovering gene regulatory differences between human and chimpanzee neural cells
1263045.title: Uncovering gene regulatory differences between human and chimpanzee neural cells
1263045.description: A major challenge in human evolutionary biology is to pinpoint the genetic differences that underlie phenotypic changes in the human lineage, such as increased neuron number and a prolonged period of neuronal maturation. 910208.name: HIV-1 Vpr targets PU.1 to vastly alter the antiviral machinery of HIV infected primary human macrophages
910208.title: HIV-1 Vpr targets PU.1 to vastly alter the antiviral machinery of HIV infected primary human macrophages
910208.description: HIV-1 accessory protein, Vpr, is required for efficient HIV-1 infection of macrophages. Here we show that Vpr reprograms macrophage gene expression by altering the activity of master transcriptional regulator, PU.1, which is responsible for regulating the expression of host immune response genes and is necessary for normal hematopoiesis. 663561.name: Shared transcriptional profiles at the single cell level of atypical memory B cells suggest common drivers of expansion and function in malaria, HIV and autoimmune diseases [Malaria VDJ+GEX scRNA-seq]
663561.title: Shared transcriptional profiles at the single cell level of atypical memory B cells suggest common drivers of expansion and function in malaria, HIV and autoimmune diseases [Malaria VDJ+GEX scRNA-seq]
663561.description: Human chronic infectious diseases have been shown to alter the composition and phenotype of the B cell compartment, which, in part, can attribute to failure to acquire protective immunity. However, the extent of such alterations is poorly understood. Here, using a combination of bulk and single cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) of B cells in individuals living in malaria-endemic Africa, we characterized changes in naïve B cell, classical memory B cell (MBC) and atypical MBC subsets. Of particular

935425.name: Structurally complex osteosarcoma genomes exhibit limited heterogeneity within individual tumors and across evolutionary time
935425.title: Structurally complex osteosarcoma genomes exhibit limited heterogeneity within individual tumors and across evolutionary time
935425.description: A key characteristic of osteosarcoma is extensive and complex genomic rearrangements. However, published models explaining how these genomic rearrangements occur disagree about if these rearrangements occur early in tumor progression and then are stable afterwards, or if there is ongoing genomic instability. 796547.name: Single Cell Characterization of Myeloma and its Precursor Conditions Reveals Transcriptional Signatures of Early Tumorigenesis
796547.title: Single Cell Characterization of Myeloma and its Precursor Conditions Reveals Transcriptional Signatures of Early Tumorigenesis
796547.description: Multiple myeloma is a plasma cell malignancy almost always preceded by precursor conditions, but low tumor burden of these early stages has hindered the study of their molecular programs through bulk sequencing technologies. Here, we generated and analyzed single cell RNA-sequencing of plasma cells from 26 patients at varying disease stages and 9 healthy donors. 610094.name: Molecular characterization of bulk and single cell prostate cancer
610094.title: Molecular characterization of bulk and single cell prostate cancer
610094.description: Version 1: We performed single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) of fresh biopsies from metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer. Additionally, where available, we performed matched bulk whole exome sequencing (WXS; tumor and normal paired) and whole transcriptome sequencing for the same individuals. 511584.name: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals compromised immune microenvironment in precursor stages of multiple myeloma
511584.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals compromised immune microenvironment in precursor stages of multiple myeloma
511584.description: Precursor states of Multiple Myeloma (MM) and its native tumor microenvironment need in-depth molecular characterization to better stratify and treat patients at risk. Using single-cell RNA sequencing of bone marrow cells from precursor stages, MGUS and smoldering myeloma (SMM), to full-blown MM alongside healthy donors, we demonstrate early immune changes during patient progression. 1270998.name: Vascular invasion-associated gene expression is detectable in pre-surgical biopsies of stage I lung adenocarcinoma [bulkRNAseq_biopsies]
1270998.title: Vascular invasion-associated gene expression is detectable in pre-surgical biopsies of stage I lung adenocarcinoma [bulkRNAseq_biopsies]
1270998.description: Microscopic vascular invasion (VI) predicts recurrence and benefit from lobectomy in stage I lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) but cannot be accurately predicted before surgery. Thus, biomarkers that identify this aggressive tumor subset are needed. Here, we show that VI in stage I LUAD is associated with reproducible gene expression programs detectable beyond the invasive focus. 741226.title: Next Generation Sequencing analysis to compare expression patterns of myeloid progenitors in healthy donors and MDS patients
741226.description: Transcriptional changes occurring in the CMPs and GMPs of untreated "CMP pattern" and "GMP pattern" MDS patients were compared with the transcriptional profile of CMPs and GMPs from healthy donors Overall design: Lin-CD34+CD38+CD123+CD45RA- CMPs and Lin-CD34+CD38+CD123+CD45RA+ GMPs were FACS-purified from mononuclear cells previoulsy isolated by density gradient from fresh bone marrow aspirates and magnetically-enriched in CD34+ cells . Total RNA was purified using the PicoPure RNA Isolation Kit

1308197.name: Sequencing of rare pancreatic tumors that respond to PD-1 blockade
1308197.title: Sequencing of rare pancreatic tumors that respond to PD-1 blockade
1308197.description: Pancreatic cancer is nearly always refractory to immunotherapy, except in a rare subset of patients whose tumors have a high mutational burden (TMB), usually due to mismatch-repair deficiency. We collected tumors and matched blood from patients with pancreatic cancer, some of whom had high-TMB disease. We performed single-cell RNA-seq analyses of those samples to understand the correlates in the pancreatic tumor microenvironment of productive responses to immunotherapy. We found that different T

1107395.name: Genomic profiles and survival prognosticators in African-American patients with acute myeloid leukemia
1107395.title: Genomic profiles and survival prognosticators in African-American patients with acute myeloid leukemia
1107395.description: Genomic profiles and prognostic biomarkers in patients with acute myeloid leukemia (AML) from ancestry diverse populations are underexplored. We analyzed the exomes and transcriptomes of 100 Black patients with AML (Alliance) and compared somatic mutation frequencies with those of 323 White patients (BeatAML). Seventy-three percent of 162 recurrent gene mutations identified in Black patients, including a novel PHIP alteration detected in 7% of patients, were found in only ≤1 White patient. Black

909402.name: Integrative Somatic and Germline Computational Biology to Redefine Clinical Actionability in Solid Tumors
909402.title: Integrative Somatic and Germline Computational Biology to Redefine Clinical Actionability in Solid Tumors
909402.description: Version 1: Neuroendocrine tumors (NETs) are rare cancers that arise in the gastrointestinal tract and pancreas. The fundamental mechanisms driving gastroenteropancreatic NETs (GEP-NETs) growth remain incompletely elucidated; however, the heterogeneous clinical behavior of GEP-NETs suggests that both cellular lineage dynamics and tumor microenvironment influence tumor pathophysiology. 1242411.name: Single Cell Opioid Responses in the Context of HIV (SCORCH)
1242411.title: Single Cell Opioid Responses in the Context of HIV (SCORCH)
1242411.description: The Single Cell Opioid Responses in the Context of HIV (SCORCH) consortium was formed to begin to address scientific questions about addiction and HIV/ART at the single cell level. Fifteen funded SCORCH data generation projects (NIDA SCORCH Program) have been generating brain snRNA-seq or snATAC-seq data. To request access to this collection, select phs003991 in the dbGaP Authorized Access System.

842222.name: Multi-modal skin atlas associates a multicellular immune-stromal community with altered cornification and T cell expansion in atopic dermatitis [scATAC-seq]
842222.title: Multi-modal skin atlas associates a multicellular immune-stromal community with altered cornification and T cell expansion in atopic dermatitis [scATAC-seq]
842222.description: In healthy skin, a cutaneous immune system maintains balance between tolerance towards innocuous environmental antigens and immune responses against pathological agents, but in atopic dermatitis (AD), barrier and immune dysfunction result in chronic tissue inflammation. 1424219.name: Interrogating gene regulation during human cortical development
1424219.title: Interrogating gene regulation during human cortical development
1424219.description: Our study investigates the regulatory function and evolutionary origins of the fastest evolved genomic regions in the human genome termed Human Ancestor Quickly Evolved Regions (HAQERs), during human cortical development. 726830.name: Characterization of CNS Metastases
726830.title: Characterization of CNS Metastases
726830.description: Metastatic disease to the central nervous system (CNS) is devastating, with a poor prognosis. There are limited treatment options for patients with CNS metastases, and in particular with leptomeningeal carcinomatosis (LMD). In this study, we evaluated the molecular and cellular features of parenchymal brain metastases and LMD. 723926.name: A single cell atlas of MMRd and MMRp colorectal cancer
723926.title: A single cell atlas of MMRd and MMRp colorectal cancer
723926.description: Immune responses to cancer vary across cancer types and patients. Colorectal cancer tumors with mismatch repair-deficiency (MMRd) show an elevated immune cell activity as compared to mismatch repair proficient (MMRp) tumors. To understand the immune response patterns in these two types of colorectal cancer, we transcriptionally profiled 371,223 tumor and adjacent normal cells from 28 MMRp and 34 MMRd patients. 545750.name: A single cell transcriptomic analysis of human neocortical development
545750.title: A single cell transcriptomic analysis of human neocortical development
545750.description: Defining the number, proportion, or lineage of distinct cell types in the developing human brain is an important goal of modern brain research. We produced single cell transcriptomic profiles for 40,000 cells at mid-gestation to define deep expression profiles corresponding to all known major cell types at this developmental period and compare this with bulk tissue profiles. 947747.name: Single Cell Genotypic and Phenotypic Analysis of Measurable Residual Disease in Acute Myeloid Leukemia
947747.title: Single Cell Genotypic and Phenotypic Analysis of Measurable Residual Disease in Acute Myeloid Leukemia
947747.description: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a group of blood cancers with high mortality. Even though complete remission is often achieved, majority of the AML patients still relapse. Measurable residual disease (MRD), defined as the population of cancer cells which persists following chemotherapy, is responsible for AML relapse. 1028777.name: Single-cell Genomic and Transcriptomic Analysis of the Aging Human Brain
1028777.title: Single-cell Genomic and Transcriptomic Analysis of the Aging Human Brain
1028777.description: We studied human brain aging using single-cell whole genome sequencing and single-nucleus RNA sequencing of the pre-frontal cortex from 19 donors ranging in age from 0.4 years to 104 years. All donors were free of neuropathology and none received a clinical neurological diagnosis prior to death. snRNA-seq libraries were prepared in batches that always included old and young donors to mitigate batch effects in the preparations. 667525.name: Characterization of high-grade serous ovarian cancer subtypes via single-cell profiling
667525.title: Characterization of high-grade serous ovarian cancer subtypes via single-cell profiling
667525.description: We measured gene expression in single-cell RNA sequencing samples from patients with high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC), for a study on improving HGSOC subtype definition by taking into account varying cell type proportions within tumors. The initial dataset (added October, 2020) contains 3 samples (3 individuals). The next dataset (added November, 2022) contains 34 samples from 8 individuals. 835732.name: Single-cell RNA-seq of CD8 T cells sorted from one sample of seropositive rheumatoid arthritis synovial fluid
835732.title: Single-cell RNA-seq of CD8 T cells sorted from one sample of seropositive rheumatoid arthritis synovial fluid
835732.description: We used FACS to sort CD8 T cells from synovial fluid mononuclear cells from one patient with seropositive rheumatoid arthritis Overall design: SFMCs were thawed, stained with MR1 tetramers and surface antibodies, and CD8 T cells (Propoidium Iodide- CD3+ CD14- CD19- MR1 tetramer- CD8α+ CD4- cells) isolated by FACS. 836693.name: Integrative Single-Cell Analysis of Transcriptome, Epigenome, and Lineage in HIV Latency and Activation
836693.title: Integrative Single-Cell Analysis of Transcriptome, Epigenome, and Lineage in HIV Latency and Activation
836693.description: With the development of triple combination antiretroviral therapy, routine HIV treatment eliminates nearly all actively infected cells. Nevertheless, the small reservoir of latently infected cells, which can remain dormant for long periods of time before becoming active and producing new virus particles, represents a crucial barrier to completely curing the disease. 1422191.name: Multi-omics profiling of genetic and transcriptomic alterations in bladder cancer
1422191.title: Multi-omics profiling of genetic and transcriptomic alterations in bladder cancer
1422191.description: This prospective study aimed to explore genetic and transcriptomic alterations in bladder cancer using multi-omics approaches. Samples were obtained from clinical investigators under Center for Cancer Research (NCI)_approved protocols, and future submissions will include samples from additional institutions. 754135.name: Multiple Nf1 Schwann cell populations reprogram the plexiform neurofibroma tumor microenvironment
754135.title: Multiple Nf1 Schwann cell populations reprogram the plexiform neurofibroma tumor microenvironment
754135.description: To define alterations early in tumor formation, we studied nerve tumors in neurofibromatosis 1 (NF1), a tumor predisposition syndrome in which affected individuals develop plexiform neurofibroma (PN). 525920.name: Conserved cell types with divergent features between human and mouse cortex
525920.title: Conserved cell types with divergent features between human and mouse cortex
525920.description: Elucidating the cellular architecture of the human neocortex is central to understanding our cognitive abilities and susceptibility to disease. In this study, we applied single nucleus RNA sequencing to perform a comprehensive analysis of cell types in the middle temporal gyrus of human cerebral cortex. 1438242.name: Multi-modal profiling reveals epithelial hierarchy disorganization underlying field cancerization in head and neck cancer
1438242.title: Multi-modal profiling reveals epithelial hierarchy disorganization underlying field cancerization in head and neck cancer
1438242.description: Local recurrence rates in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) exceed 50%, potentially due to field cancerization, a phenomenon where tissue that appears normal microscopically actually harbors molecular changes that can give rise to new tumors. The prevailing model assumes these "at-risk" tissues share driver mutations with adjacent tumors, but whether field cancerization depends solely on mutations remains unknown. 1312892.name: Clinicogenomic analysis of EGFR-mutant lung tumors identifies Rb inactivation as a hallmark of squamous transformation
1312892.title: Clinicogenomic analysis of EGFR-mutant lung tumors identifies Rb inactivation as a hallmark of squamous transformation
1312892.description: Histologic transformation to squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) is an underrecognized mechanism of resistance to treatment in EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD). While small cell lung cancer (SCLC) transformation has been better characterized, the molecular basis of LUSC transformation remains poorly defined. 823928.name: Melanoma Brain Metastasis Atlas [SlideSeq]
823928.title: Melanoma Brain Metastasis Atlas [SlideSeq]
823928.description: We performed single-cell/nuclei RNA-sequencing (sc/snRNA-seq) of 22 treatment-naïve melanoma brain metastases (MBM; 5 samples using scRNA-seq and 17 snRNA-seq) from 21 patients and 10 treatment-naïve peripheral (extracranial) metastases (ECM; all snRNA-seq) from 10 patients. We performed matched spatial sequencing using SlideSeq2 (n=16) on 11 snRNA-seq samples. 1281737.name: B cell lymphocytosis and reprogramming due to a CARD11 bi-allelic gain-of-function mutation
1281737.title: B cell lymphocytosis and reprogramming due to a CARD11 bi-allelic gain-of-function mutation
1281737.description: This is a single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) study using peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) from 2 healthy donors and 2 patients with B cell Expansion with NF-_B and T cell Anergy (BENTA). Samples were not hashed or multiplexed. The 10X Genomics Platform was used for sequencing. Principal findings include transcriptome changes due to mono- or bi-allelic mutations in the gene CARD11. FASTA files will be available through dbGaP.

1023367.name: Children's Hospital of Philadelphia  B- and T-cell Acute Leukemia and Lymphomas
1023367.title: Children's Hospital of Philadelphia  B- and T-cell Acute Leukemia and Lymphomas
1023367.description: Our goal with this study was to identify the mechanisms of treatment resistance in T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) using single-cell genomics. We profiled 40 T-ALL cases from the Children's Oncology Group AALL0434 clinical trial using CITE-seq/snATAC-seq, capturing a breadth of immunophenotypes, including early T-cell precursor (ETP) and near-ETP/non-ETP subtypes. 772733.name: T cell characteristics associated with toxicity to immune checkpoint blockade in patients with melanoma [bulk RNA-seq]
772733.title: T cell characteristics associated with toxicity to immune checkpoint blockade in patients with melanoma [bulk RNA-seq]
772733.description: Severe immune-related adverse events (irAEs) occur in up to 60% of melanoma patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). 892707.name: Multi-modal single-cell and whole-genome sequencing of small, frozen clinical specimens
892707.title: Multi-modal single-cell and whole-genome sequencing of small, frozen clinical specimens
892707.description: Clinical application of single-cell sequencing technologies has been hampered by their need for quick processing of relatively large, fresh specimens. Here, we benchmarked the performance of a new technique for single-cell sequencing from snap-frozen clinical samples, vs. sequencing from fresh samples, on 5 samples from cutaneous melanoma brain metastasis, 6 samples from NSCLC brain metastasis, and 3 from uveal melanoma primary tumor. 431831.name: Single-cell RNA-seq of rheumatoid arthritis synovial tissue using low-cost microfluidic instrumentation
431831.title: Single-cell RNA-seq of rheumatoid arthritis synovial tissue using low-cost microfluidic instrumentation
431831.description: Droplet-based single-cell RNA-seq has emerged as a powerful technique for massively parallel cellular profiling. While these approaches offer the exciting promise to deconvolute cellular heterogeneity in diseased tissues, the lack of cost-effective, reliable, and user-friendly instrumentation has hindered widespread adoption of droplet microfluidic techniques. To address this, we have developed a microfluidic control instrument that can be easily assembled from 3D printed parts and commercially

809638.name: Differential dynamics of response at single cell resolution following CAR-T therapy in refractory B-cell lymphoma
809638.title: Differential dynamics of response at single cell resolution following CAR-T therapy in refractory B-cell lymphoma
809638.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing of PBMCs and infusion products from 32 patients treated with CD19 CAR-T therapy Overall design: Single-cell RNA sequencing of PBMCs and infusion products from 32 patients treated with CD19 CAR-T therapy NOTE FROM SUBMITTER: Raw sequencing data will be available at controlled access,  dbGAP.

876016.name: JSS transcriptome study
876016.title: JSS transcriptome study
876016.description: Sjogren's disease (SjD) is a systemic autoimmune disorder with major clinical manifestations of dryness in the eyes and mouth, fatigue, and joint pain. Our interdisciplinary experts in SjD at the University of Florida newly discovered and established a cohort of SjD in children. Many of these patients with childhood SjD (cSjD) demonstrated a prominent feature of recurrent parotitis (RP). 949663.name: Using single-cell transcriptomics to characterise early mechanisms of psoriasis resolution
949663.title: Using single-cell transcriptomics to characterise early mechanisms of psoriasis resolution
949663.description: We obtained full-thickness skin biopsies from five individuals with severe psoriasis who were receiving risankizumab treatment. Skin biopsies were taken from lesional and non-lesional sites at baseline, and from lesional sites at day 3 and day 14 of therapy. Single-cell RNA sequencing was performed using a 10x Genomics platform. Overall design: Longitudinal single-cell RNA-sequencing of skin biopsies obtained from 5 individuals with severe psoriasis. 1018859.name: Defining the Regulatory Logic of Breast Cancer Using Single-Cell Epigenetic and Transcriptome Profiling
1018859.title: Defining the Regulatory Logic of Breast Cancer Using Single-Cell Epigenetic and Transcriptome Profiling
1018859.description: Annotation of the cis-regulatory elements mediating oncogenic transcription is essential to understanding breast cancer biology. In this work, we quantitatively linked variation in chromatin accessibility to gene expression within human breast tumors, normal mammary reduction tissue samples, and breast cancer cell lines using single-cell chromatin accessibility sequencing (scATAC-seq) and single-cell transcriptomic sequencing (scRNA-seq). 547653.name: Cross-species Single Cell Analysis of Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Reveals Antigen-presenting Cancer-associated Fibroblasts
547653.title: Cross-species Single Cell Analysis of Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Reveals Antigen-presenting Cancer-associated Fibroblasts
547653.description: Cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are major players in the progression and drug resistance of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). CAFs constitute a diverse cell population consisting of several recently described subtypes, although the extent of CAF heterogeneity has remained undefined. Here we employ single-cell RNA-sequencing to thoroughly characterize the neoplastic and tumor microenvironment content of human PDAC tumors. 603848.title: Molecular Biomarkers in Glioma (Mechanisms and therapeutic implications of hypermutation in gliomas)
603848.description: This study seeks to genomically and mechanistically examine the basis for resistance of glioblastoma to chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and targeted therapy including immunotherapies. The study design addresses two Aims. 954383.name: Analysis of donor pancreata defines the transcriptomic signature and microenvironment of early neoplastic lesions.
954383.title: Analysis of donor pancreata defines the transcriptomic signature and microenvironment of early neoplastic lesions.
954383.description: The adult healthy human pancreas has been poorly studied given lack of indication to obtain tissue from the pancreas in the absence of disease and rapid postmortem degradation. We obtained pancreata from brain dead donors thus avoiding any warm ischemia time. We found that neoplastic lesions occur frequently in healthy organs, in donors as young as in their 3rd decade of life. 1018219.name: Profiling of Sarcomas from Archival Tissues [lp-WGS]
1018219.title: Profiling of Sarcomas from Archival Tissues [lp-WGS]
1018219.description: We performed single nuclei RNA-sequencing (snRNA-seq) with matched T cell receptor sequencing (TCR-seq), and pool matched low pass whole genome sequencing (WGS) of eight specimens from six patients, encompassing four undifferentiated polymorphic sarcomas (UPS)  and four intimal sarcomas (INS), and paired specimens from two patients (one UPS and INS each) treated with immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). 1003845.name: Single Nucleus Transcriptomes from the Ventral Midbrain of Opioid Overdose Cases and Controls
1003845.title: Single Nucleus Transcriptomes from the Ventral Midbrain of Opioid Overdose Cases and Controls
1003845.description: Dynamic interactions of neurons and glia in the ventral midbrain (VM) mediate reward and addiction behavior. We studied gene expression in 212,713 VM single nuclei from 95 human opioid overdose cases and drug-free controls. 891357.name: Decoding the endometrial niche of Asherman's syndrome at single-cell resolution
891357.title: Decoding the endometrial niche of Asherman's syndrome at single-cell resolution
891357.description: Asherman’s Syndrome is characterized by intrauterine adhesions or scarring, which cause infertility, menstrual abnormalities, and recurrent pregnancy loss. The pathophysiology of this syndrome remains unknown, with treatment restricted to recurrent surgical removal of intrauterine scarring, which has limited success. 849968.name: SARS-CoV-2 induced immune perturbations in infants vary with disease severity and differ from adults’ responses
849968.title: SARS-CoV-2 induced immune perturbations in infants vary with disease severity and differ from adults’ responses
849968.description: Differences in immune profiles of children and adults with COVID-19 have been previously described. However, no systematic studies have been reported from infants hospitalized with severe disease. We applied a multidimensional approach to decipher the immune responses of SARS-CoV-2 infected infants (n=26; 10 subacute, 11 moderate and 5 severe disease; median age=1.6 months) and matched controls (n=14; median age=2 months). Single cell (scRNA-seq) profiling of PBMCs revealed substantial alteratio

999324.name: SARS-CoV-2 infection elucidates unique features of pregnancy-specific immunity [VDJ]
999324.title: SARS-CoV-2 infection elucidates unique features of pregnancy-specific immunity [VDJ]
999324.description: Pregnancy is a risk factor for increased severity of SARS-CoV-2 and other respiratory infections. The mechanisms underlying this risk have not been well-established, partly due to limited understanding of how pregnancy shapes and modulates immune responses. 407354.description: Combined transcriptomic and functional analyses of HCC cells at single-cell level were performed to assess CSC heterogeneity. 287185.title: Melanoma Exome Sequencing
287185.description: This study reports on genomic profiling [whole-exome sequencing (WXS), bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq), and/or single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq)] of patient-derived melanoma samples and matched normal samples. The goal is to elucidate the genetic and cellular basis of sun-exposed and sun-shielded melanomas and to relate these findings to survival and regional metastasis. 895392.name: Single-cell multi-omic analysis of the vestibular schwannoma ecosystem uncovers a nerve injury-like state [scRNA-seq]
895392.title: Single-cell multi-omic analysis of the vestibular schwannoma ecosystem uncovers a nerve injury-like state [scRNA-seq]
895392.description: Vestibular schwannomas (VS) are benign tumors that lead to significant neurologic and otologic morbidity. How VS heterogeneity and the tumor microenvironment (TME) contribute to the pathogenesis of these tumors remains poorly understood. We performed scRNA-seq on 15 VS samples, with paired scATAC-seq (n=6)  and exome sequencing (n=12). 885844.title: Tri-modal Single Cell Approach Reveals Cellular and Molecular Heterogeneity in Naïve T cells Across Human Age
885844.description: The naïve T cell compartment undergoes multiple changes across age that associate with altered susceptibility to infection and autoimmunity. In addition to the acquisition of naïve-like memory T cell subsets, recent murine studies describe substantial molecular reprogramming of the naïve compartment in adults compared with adolescents. 1119954.name: RNA-seq of monocyte derived macrophages and dendritic cells in a Peruvian Tuberculosis cohort
1119954.title: RNA-seq of monocyte derived macrophages and dendritic cells in a Peruvian Tuberculosis cohort
1119954.description: In this study, we sought to analyze the effects of genetic variants on gene expression levels in relation to the history of infectious disease and cell type. To do this, we focused on a Peruvian human cohort that had been previously genotyped who either progressed to active tuberculosis (TB) disease (cases) or did not progress to TB (controls). 1374225.title: Establishing and benchmarking advanced methods to comprehensively characterize somatic genome variation in single human cells
1374225.description: Understanding somatic genomic variation presents unique challenges, primarily stemming from the individual rarity of most somatic mutations across cells in a multicellular organism. Hence, both sensitivity and accuracy (due to the need to distinguish somatic variation from noise) become crucially important. 1211202.title: Multiomic Landscape of Multiple Myeloma Precursor and Relapsed Disease
1211202.description: Multiple myeloma (MM) is a treatable, though incurable, plasma cell malignancy. The molecular mechanisms driving disease onset and the emergence of drug resistance remain elusive. 1072033.title: PanIN and CAF Transitions in Pancreatic Carcinogenesis Revealed with Spatial Data Integration
1072033.description: This study introduces a new imaging, spatial transcriptomics (ST), and single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) integration pipeline to characterize neoplastic cell state transitions during tumorigenesis. 1196903.title: Inferring differential dynamics from multi-lineage, multi-omic, and multi-sample single-cell data
1196903.description: Understanding the gene regulatory mechanisms that establish and maintain cell type identities is a central goal in cellular and developmental biology. 871024.title: Single cell genome variation induced by mutational processes in cancer - HGSOC Trios study
871024.description: Mutational signatures derived from whole genome sequencing have potential prognostic significance. 928660.name: Mechanisms of response and resistance to combined decitabine and ipilimumab for advanced myeloid disease
928660.title: Mechanisms of response and resistance to combined decitabine and ipilimumab for advanced myeloid disease
928660.description: The ETCTN 10026 study tested decitabine and ipilimumab for transplant-naive advanced myelodysplastic syndrome/acute myeloid leukemia and relapsed acute myeloid leukemia after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. 616334.title: The immune cell atlas of human neuroblastoma
616334.description: Our current knowledge of the different immune cells in neuroblastoma is based on in vitro and in vivo studies mainly focusing on a single cell type. Importantly, different studies have conveyed conflicting results. 1014564.title: Resistance development in basal cell nevus syndrome through the basal to squamous transition
1014564.description: While basal cell carcinomas (BCCs) arise from ectopic hedgehog pathway activation and can be treated with pathway inhibitors, sporadic BCCs display high resistance rates, while tumors arising in Gorlin syndrome patients with germline Patched (PTCH1) mutations are uniformly suppressed by inhibitor therapy. 1062913.title: Cell type-specific and disease-associated eQTL in the human lung
1062913.description: This study was conducted to investigate the genetic control of gene expression in a cell-type and context-specific manner in the human lung. We performed single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) of lung tissue from 66 Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD) cases and 48 unaffected donors. 1095026.title: Physical Resiliencies: Indicators and Mechanisms in the Elderly (PRIME)
1095026.description: In this study, we utilized single-cell RNA sequencing and flow cytometry to characterize latent cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection at the transcriptional level in older individuals (aged 60 and above) at baseline (using peripheral blood; PBMCs). 974175.title: Adipocytes regulate fibroblast function, and their loss contributes to fibroblast dysfunction in inflammatory diseases

744859.title: Single cell analysis reveals mechanisms of heterogeneity and plasticity of leukemia initiating cells [ChIP-Seq]

667526.title: Characterization of high-grade serous ovarian cancer subtypes via single-cell profiling
667526.description: We measured gene expression in single-cell RNA sequencing samples from patients with high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC), for a study on improving HGSOC subtype definition by taking into account varying cell type proportions within tumors. 955805.title: Lineage and ecology define liver tumor evolution in response to treatment
955805.description: Single-cell transcriptome-based strategy to determine the evolutionary trajectories of longitudinal tumor biopsies from liver cancer patients by measuring cellular lineage and ecology. 341752.title: Region-Specific Neural Stem Cell Lineages Revealed By Single-Cell RNA-Seq From Human Embryonic Stem Cells

1173251.title: MR1T Cells at Birth Have Diverse TCR Usage, are Less Cytotoxic and are Unable to Respond to Many Common Childhood Pathogens

1259607.title: Single-cell atlas of human liver and blood immune cells across fatty liver disease stages
1259607.description: The goal of the study was to investigate immunological correlates of human fatty liver disease progression. 878787.title: Lung endothelial cells regulate pulmonary fibrosis through FOXF1/R-Ras signaling (Human).

1253784.title: Revealing the single cell determinants of brain relevant to persistent HIV infection and opioid use disorder

497875.title: Single-Cell Transcriptomic Analysis of Human Lung Reveals Complex Multicellular Changes During Pulmonary Fibrosis

We performed massively parallel single-cell RNA-Seq on lung tissue from eight lung transplant donors and eight patients with pulmonary fibrosis. 606952.name: Single Cell sequencing of human Sputum cells in cystic fibrosis and healthy controls
606952.title: Single Cell sequencing of human Sputum cells in cystic fibrosis and healthy controls
606952.description: The study aimed to compare the gene expression profiles at a single cell level in Sputum cells between patients with cystic fibrosis (CF) and disease controls (CTRL). Overall design: Single-cell RNA sequencing data was generated from Sputum of 9 CF patients (10 libraries) and 5 CTRL Raw data to be made available through dbGaP

Identification of high grade serous ovarian cancer patients with deficiency in homologous recombination repair pathways could identify a subset of patients that would benefit from homologous recombination deficiency-specific treatments independent of identification of a pathological BRCA1/2 gene mutation. 836692.title: Integrative Single-Cell Analysis of Transcriptome, Epigenome, and Lineage in HIV Latency and Activation
836692.description: With the development of triple combination antiretroviral therapy, routine HIV treatment eliminates nearly all actively infected cells. Nevertheless, the small reservoir of latently infected cells, which can remain dormant for long periods of time before becoming active and producing new virus particles, represents a crucial barrier to completely curing the disease. 387321.name: Integrated single cell genetic and transcriptional analysis suggests novel private drivers of chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
387321.title: Integrated single cell genetic and transcriptional analysis suggests novel private drivers of chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

In order to more accurately identify subclones, define phylogenetic relationships, and probe genotype-phenotype relationships, we developed methods for targeted mutation detection in DNA and RNA isolated from thousands of single cells from five CLL samples. 935028.name: Single cell colony whole genome sequencing data from individuals with telomere syndromes
935028.title: Single cell colony whole genome sequencing data from individuals with telomere syndromes
935028.description: This is an observational study which examined the phylogenetic evolution of somatic clonal mutations in individuals with Mendelian telomere syndromes. It includes data from two individuals who carry a heterozygous germline POT1 variant, 5 individuals with heterozygous germline mutations in telomerase (TERT or TERC) and one healthy control with normal telomere length. 528020.title: Single-cell lymphocyte heterogeneity inadvanced Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma skin tumors
528020.description: Purpose: The heterogeneity of tumor cells presents a major challenge to cancer diagnosis and therapy. 629811.title: Chronic Malaria drives functional heterogenity in B cell subpopulations and expansion of unswitched atypical memory B cells [Malaria bulkRNA-seq]
629811.description: Human chronic infectious diseases have been shown to alter the composition and phenotype of the B cell compartment, which, in part, can attribute to failure to acquire protective immunity. Here, using a combination of bulk and single cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) of B cells in individuals living in malaria-endemic Africa, we characterized changes in naïve B cell, classical memory B cell (MBC) and atypical MBC subsets. 1369580.title: Single nucleus and spatial transcriptomic analyses of pulmonary fibrosis from the “Lung Transplant” and “Lung Tissue” Biorepositories
1369580.description: Interstitial lung disease (ILD) is characterized by a progressive destruction of the lung parenchyma driven by complex interactions between epithelial, stromal and immune cells. To understand the cellular programs and interactions involved in ILD, we performed single nucleus and spatial transcriptomic analyses of lung tissues from ILD patients or comparators. 1427260.title: Synchronous dual hematologic neoplasms of myeloid and lymphoid lineage are of common clonal origin
1427260.description: Synchronous dual hematologic neoplasms (SDHN) of myeloid and lymphoid lineages occur more frequently than expected based on their respective disease epidemiology. However, whether these entities are clonally related is unknown. 655238.title: Multimodal Mapping of the Tumor and Peripheral Blood Immune Landscape in Human Pancreatic Cancer

691175.title: Biallelic loss of BCMA as a resistance mechanism to CAR T cell therapy in a patient with Multiple Myeloma
691175.description: BCMA targeting chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy have shown deep and durable responses in multiple myeloma. However, relapse following therapy is frequently observed, and mechanisms of resistance remain ill-defined. We performed single cell genomic characterization of longitudinal samples from a patient who relapsed after initial CAR T cell treatment with lack of response to retreatment. 644898.title: A single-cell chromatin accessibility map of pulmonary alveologenesis in humans and mice
644898.description: Regulation of lung responses to air breathing and continued alveolar development shape ex-utero and adult respiratory health.  Applying single-cell transposome hypersensitive site sequencing (scTHS-seq) to human and mouse lung, we assembled a regulatory atlas of postnatal lung development and analyzed over 80,000 single-cells.  From day of life 1, we characterized cell types and cell-cell interactions driving alveoli generation.  We elucidated key transcription factor-gene accessibility modules

1014560.name: Immune Responses in Checkpoint Myocarditis Across Heart, Blood, and Tumor
1014560.title: Immune Responses in Checkpoint Myocarditis Across Heart, Blood, and Tumor
1014560.description: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) are widely used in anti-cancer therapies, but they can cause morbid and potentially fatal immune-related adverse events (irAEs), such as ICI-related myocarditis (irMyocarditis). The pathogenesis of irMyocarditis and its relationship to anti-tumor immunity remain poorly understood. 1293470.title: Long-read Genome and Single-Nucleus Multiome Sequencing of Brain Tissue from Colombian Individuals with Neurodegenerative Diseases

976485.title: Type I interferon and cycling lymphocytes in macrophage activation syndrome
976485.description: We performed immune profiling of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from patients with Still's disease and macrophage activation syndrome (MAS) using bulk RNA sequencing and single-cell RNA sequencing. 1209133.title: Developing targeted therapy for patients with Multiple Myeloma and Amp1q
1209133.description: Multiple myeloma (MM) frequently presents with gain or amplification of chr1q (1q+), which is associated with inferior response to treatment and poor outcomes. 756265.title: The Landscape of Tumor Cell States and Ecosystems in Diffuse Large B Cell Lymphoma [scRNA-seq]
756265.description: Biological heterogeneity in diffuse large B cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is partly driven by cell-of-origin subtypes and associated genomic lesions, but also by diverse cell types and cell states in the tumor microenvironment (TME). 1240349.title: Uncovering gene regulatory differences between human and chimpanzee neural cells [scRNA-seq]

950416.description: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) can offer remarkable benefits to patients with cancer, but these agents can cause morbid and potentially fatal immune-related adverse events (irAEs), the most lethal of which is ICI-related myocarditis (irMyocarditis). 849981.title: Colitis associated with immune checkpoint inhibitors [tissue_cells]

606619.name: Genomic landscape of human skin at a single-cell resolution
606619.title: Genomic landscape of human skin at a single-cell resolution
606619.description: Every cell in the human body has a unique set of somatic mutations, yet it remains difficult to comprehensively genotype an individual cell. Here, we developed solutions to overcome this obstacle in the context of normal human skin, thus offering the first glimpse into the genomic landscapes of melanocytes at single-cell resolution. In this study, we investigate a model in which this mutational acquisition occurs serially in long-lived self-renewing hematopoietic stem cells eventually resulting in frank acute myeloid leukemia. 782616.title: Integrative molecular and clinical profiling of acral melanoma links focal amplification of chr22q11.21 to metastasis
782616.description: Acral melanoma, the most common melanoma subtype among non-Caucasian individuals, is associated with poor prognosis. However, its key molecular drivers remain obscure. 576726.title: Clonally expanded T cells reveal immunogenicity of rhabdoid tumors
576726.description: Rhabdoid tumors (RT) are cancers of early childhood and are driven by loss of SWI/SNF components, most frequently SMARCB1, but with low somatic mutation burdens otherwise. 698273.title: Cardiac cell type-specific gene regulatory programs and disease risk association [ATAC-seq]

896957.title: Integrative Single Cell Multiomic Profiling Analysis Reveals HOX-PBX Gene Regulatory Network Regulating the Survival of mTOR Hyperactive Cells [snRNA-Seq]

1276622.title: Single cell transcriptional analysis of human adenoids identifies molecular features of airway microfold cells
1276622.description: We aimed to characterize the cellular composition and molecular features of the human adenoid, a mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue located in the upper airway, with a focus on epithelial populations involved in immune surveillance. 1333513.title: Epigenetic Determinants and Mechanisms Influencing Genital Chlamydia trachomatis Reinfection in African American Women

336365.title: Single-cell DNA and RNA sequencing over a 29 year period of a CLL patient demonstrating evolution of multiple cell clones
